aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abdi.title: Abdi
abdi.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abdi.note: A Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named once, as an ancestor of Ethan the musician.

abdiel.title: Abdiel
abdiel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abdiel.note: A Gadite chief, listed once in the tribal genealogy. Nothing further is recorded.

abdon.title: Abdon
abdon.note: A Levitical town in Asher's territory, also written Ebron. It shows up in the allotment lists and barely anywhere else.

abdon-4.title: Abdon
abdon-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abdon-4.note: A Benjamite name in the Chronicles family lists, carried by a man who gets one verse.

abdon-2.title: Abdon
abdon-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
abdon-2.note: A name in the Benjamite genealogies, listed twice in the same family and no more than that.

abi-albon.title: Abi-albon
abi-albon.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abi-albon.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

abiah.title: Abiah
abiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abiah.note: A name shared by kings, priests and Levites, which is why it covers so much ground. The one who gets the most space is Rehoboam's son, who ruled Judah for a short time and beat Jeroboam's army while badly outnumbered.

abiah-2.title: Abiah
abiah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abiah-2.note: One of 8 men called Abiah. This one is a woman from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

abiathar.title: Abiathar
abiathar.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
abiathar.note: He was the only priest to get out of Nob alive when Saul had the place killed, and he went straight to David and stayed his priest through the running years and the reign. At the end he backed Adonijah instead of Solomon, and Solomon sent him away from the priesthood rather than kill him.

abida.title: Abida
abida.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abida.note: A son of Midian, which makes him Abraham's grandson through Keturah, the wife he took after Sarah died. The line is counted among the Arab tribes east and south of Canaan.

abiel.title: Abiel
abiel.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
abiel.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

abiezer-3.title: Abiezer
abiezer-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abiezer-3.note: Manasseh's genealogy names a third Abiezer, once, and nowhere else.

abiezer.title: Abiezer
abiezer.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abiezer.note: A warrior from the united-kingdom years who carries the clan's name. Nothing links him to Gideon's family beyond the spelling.

abigal.title: Abigal
abigal.about: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy
abigal.note: A variant spelling of Abigail, David's wife. She rode out to stop David wiping out her first husband Nabal's household, and it worked. Once Nabal was dead she married David.

abigal-2.title: Abigal
abigal-2.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
abigal-2.note: A different woman of the same name from the same years, named only in genealogical lists.

abihail-3.title: Abihail
abihail-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abihail-3.note: Named once, in a genealogy out of the divided-kingdom years.

abihail-2.title: Abihail
abihail-2.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abihail-2.note: A woman in a family list, named once. Nothing else is recorded.

abihu.title: Abihu
abihu.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abihu.note: Aaron's second son. He and his brother Nadab brought fire the Lord had not asked for and died on the spot, and Aaron was not allowed to mourn them in public.

abihud.title: Abihud
abihud.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abihud.note: Bela's son and Benjamin's grandson, listed with the family heads. The same chapter calls him Ahihud a few verses on, which is normal for these lists.

abijah-2.title: Abijah
abijah-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
abijah-2.note: A levite from the united kingdom. 1 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice.

abijah-3.title: Abijah
abijah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abijah-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

abijah-4.title: Abijah
abijah-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abijah-4.note: A man from the wilderness years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

abimael.title: Abimael
abimael.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abimael.note: Down Joktan's line in the Table of Nations. That family is generally placed in southern Arabia.

abimelech.title: Abimelech
abimelech.note: Gideon's son by a concubine. He killed almost all seventy of his brothers to clear his own way, which is most of what Judges has to say about him.

abinadab-3.title: Abinadab
abinadab-3.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
abinadab-3.note: One of David's older brothers, named in the family lists and not much else.

abinadab.title: Abinadab
abinadab.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
abinadab.note: A son of Saul, who died alongside his father.

abinadab-2.title: Abinadab
abinadab-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
abinadab-2.note: The man whose house held the ark. It sat there twenty years before David came for it.

abishai.title: Abishai
abishai.about: David's warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abishai.note: David's nephew, and the most willing man he had. He is credited with three hundred killed on his own. Twice he offered to finish one of David's enemies on the spot, Saul asleep in the camp and Shimei cursing on the road, and both times David told him no.

abishalom.title: Abishalom
abishalom.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
abishalom.note: This is Absalom, David's third son. He killed his half-brother Amnon for raping their sister Tamar, and when David punished neither of them he spent years quietly building support before taking the throne by force. The revolt ended with his famous hair caught in an oak while he was still riding.

abishua-2.title: Abishua
abishua-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abishua-2.note: Another man of the name. He is a descendant of Benjamin, named once in the tribal genealogies.

abishua.title: Abishua
abishua.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abishua.note: He is a high priest in Aaron's line. Chronicles runs the chain through him, and Ezra picks it up again centuries later.

abishur.title: Abishur
abishur.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abishur.note: One of Shammai's two sons, down Jerahmeel's branch of Judah, and the lists say nothing else about him.

abital.title: Abital
abital.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
abital.note: The fifth wife on David's list, and the mother of Shephatiah, who was born while David was still ruling from Hebron.

abitub.title: Abitub
abitub.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abitub.note: A Benjamite, listed once among Shaharaim's descendants and nowhere else in the record.

abner.title: Abner
abner.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
abner.note: Saul's cousin, and the commander of his army. When Saul died he did not stop: he kept the war going between David and what was left of Saul's house.

abraham.title: Abraham
abraham.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abraham.note: God called him out of Ur and he went at seventy-five, which is most of what you need to know about him. The nation came out of that.

abram.title: Abram
abram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abram.note: Abraham's name before God changed it, in the covenant of Genesis 17. Same man, earlier chapters.

achar.title: Achar
achar.note: Chronicles uses this spelling for Achan, the Judahite whose hidden plunder cost Israel the fight at Ai.

achbor-2.title: Achbor
achbor-2.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
achbor-2.note: A different Achbor entirely, from the time of the patriarchs. Genesis names him only as somebody's father.

achsah-2.title: Achsah
achsah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
achsah-2.note: The same name again in Caleb's genealogy. One verse in Chronicles, and nothing more.

adaiah-2.title: Adaiah
adaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adaiah-2.note: Another of the name from the divided-kingdom years. He gets a single genealogy verse.

adaiah.title: Adaiah
adaiah.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
adaiah.note: He is a priest in the returning community. The Levite lists name him and nothing else does.

adam.title: Adam
adam.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
adam.note: The first man. The name is the ordinary Hebrew word for man, which is the point of it.

adbeel.title: Adbeel
adbeel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
adbeel.note: Third of Ishmael's twelve sons. Each of the twelve ended up heading an Arabian tribal confederation.

addar.title: Addar
addar.note: A son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin. Genesis and Numbers call him Ard.

ader.title: Ader
ader.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ader.note: He is a Benjaminite leader, son of Beriah, among the family heads settled in Aijalon. Some manuscripts spell the name Eder.

adiel.title: Adiel
adiel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adiel.note: Father of one of David's treasury officials, and that is his whole appearance in the record.

adiel-2.title: Adiel
adiel-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adiel-2.note: A Simeonite clan leader carrying the same name. One verse in Chronicles.

adiel-3.title: Adiel
adiel-3.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
adiel-3.note: Third man of the name, a priest in the Chronicles genealogies.

adina.title: Adina
adina.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adina.note: He was a Reubenite who led thirty men, and he served among David's warriors.

adlai.title: Adlai
adlai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adlai.note: Father of Shaphat, the man who looked after David's cattle out in the valleys. That is his whole appearance.

adonijah.title: Adonijah
adonijah.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
adonijah.note: David's fourth son. With his older brothers dead, he was the presumed heir. He tried to have himself crowned while David was still dying, and left Solomon, Nathan and Benaiah off the invitation.

adullam.title: Adullam
adullam.note: A Canaanite royal city in the Shephelah, near the valley of Elah. David killed Goliath in that valley. Later, running from Saul, he hid in a cave near Adullam, and his family joined him there, and so did everyone in distress.

aharah.title: Aharah
aharah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aharah.note: Benjamin's third son in the 1 Chronicles 8 list. Numbers calls him Ahiram and 1 Chronicles 7 calls him Aher, likely the same man, since the lists of Benjamin's sons vary.

aharhel.title: Aharhel
aharhel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
aharhel.note: A descendant of Harum's clan, in a short and difficult fragment of Judah's genealogy that leaves little else to reconstruct.

ahaz.title: Ahaz
ahaz.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahaz.note: He abandoned his predecessors' reforms, sacrificed his own son in the fire and closed the temple. Facing a coalition of enemies, he paid Assyria for protection instead of trusting the promise Isaiah brought, and Judah stayed an Assyrian vassal for a generation. The Immanuel prophecy was given in his crisis.

ahaz-2.title: Ahaz
ahaz-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahaz-2.note: Not the king of Judah. This Ahaz appears only in the family lists at 1 Chronicles 8:35 and 9:42, and nothing else about him is recorded.

ahaziah.title: Ahaziah
ahaziah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahaziah.note: Ahab's grandson through his mother Athaliah, and king of Judah for only one year. He was killed in the same purge that brought Jehu to power.

ahban.title: Ahban
ahban.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahban.note: A son of Abishur and his wife Abihail in Judah's genealogy, and nothing more is known.

aher.title: Aher
aher.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
aher.note: Some identify him with Ahiram, Benjamin's son in Numbers 26:38. Here he is a Benjamite ancestor of Hushim in 1 Chronicles 7:12.

ahi.title: Ahi
ahi.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahi.note: Ahi means brother, and this one was a chief of a family of Gad living in Bashan.

ahi-2.title: Ahi
ahi-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahi-2.note: The name means my brother. Two unrelated men in Chronicles carry it, and this is the one in Asher's line.

ahiam.title: Ahiam
ahiam.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ahiam.note: Son of Sharar the Hararite, and one of David's thirty mighty warriors. Chronicles calls his father Sacar. Nothing further is recorded.

ahian.title: Ahian
ahian.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahian.note: From Shemida's line, in Manasseh's genealogy east of the Jordan, with nothing further recorded.

ahiezer-2.title: Ahiezer
ahiezer-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahiezer-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

ahihud.title: Ahihud
ahihud.note: Benjamin's grandson through Bela, and head of one of the families deported from Geba to Manahath. He is not the Ahihud of Asher who helped divide the land.

ahijah-4.title: Ahijah
ahijah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahijah-4.note: One of 8 men called Ahijah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ahijah-3.title: Ahijah
ahijah-3.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahijah-3.note: A man from the united kingdom, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

ahijah-5.title: Ahijah
ahijah-5.note: A man from the years before the monarchy. 1 Chronicles names him once.

ahijah-2.title: Ahijah
ahijah-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahijah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

ahilud.title: Ahilud
ahilud.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahilud.note: Two of his sons served kings: Jehoshaphat was David's royal recorder, and Baana governed one of Solomon's twelve districts.

ahimaaz.title: Ahimaaz
ahimaaz.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahimaaz.note: Zadok's son, who carried intelligence to David during Absalom's rebellion. After the battle he raced another messenger to be first with the news.

ahiman-2.title: Ahiman
ahiman-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
ahiman-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

ahimelech-2.title: Ahimelech
ahimelech-2.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahimelech-2.note: A priest in David's time, named in the list at 2 Samuel 8:17 and in the priestly divisions of 1 Chronicles 24. He is not the priest of Nob, who belongs to Saul's years.

ahimoth.title: Ahimoth
ahimoth.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahimoth.note: A Kohathite Levite in 1 Chronicles 6, whom the same genealogy later calls Mahath.

ahinoam.title: Ahinoam
ahinoam.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
ahinoam.note: The Ahinoam from Jezreel whom David married, mother of his firstborn son Amnon, and a different woman from Saul's wife of the same name.

ahio-3.title: Ahio
ahio-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahio-3.note: One of 3 men called Ahio. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ahio.title: Ahio
ahio.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahio.note: He and his brother Uzzah were guiding the cart that carried the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem. Uzzah reached out to steady it and was struck dead.

ahio-2.title: Ahio
ahio-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ahio-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

ahishar.title: Ahishar
ahishar.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahishar.note: Listed once in the tribal genealogies, at 1 Chronicles 7:10, and nothing else about him is recorded.

ahithophel.title: Ahithophel
ahithophel.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
ahithophel.note: David's most trusted counsellor, whose advice was treated as if it came from God. He went over to Absalom. When Absalom turned down his plan for a rival counsellor's, Ahithophel saw the rebellion was finished, went home, put his affairs in order and hanged himself.

ahitub.title: Ahitub
ahitub.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahitub.note: Ahimelech's father, in Israel's high priestly line.

ahitub-3.title: Ahitub
ahitub-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahitub-3.note: Generations further down the same priestly line, a later Ahitub appears in 1 Chronicles 6 and again at Ezra 7:2.

ahitub-2.title: Ahitub
ahitub-2.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahitub-2.note: Zadok's father, named in the list of officials at 2 Samuel 8:17 and in the priestly genealogy of Chronicles.

ahlai.title: Ahlai
ahlai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahlai.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

ahlai-2.title: Ahlai
ahlai-2.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahlai-2.note: Sheshan had no sons, so this Ahlai is usually taken to be his daughter, the one through whom the family line went on by way of an Egyptian servant, Jarha.

ahoah.title: Ahoah
ahoah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahoah.note: A son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin. The same chapter also calls him Ahiah, and elsewhere he is Iri. His descendants, the Ahohites, include Eleazar, one of David's three chief mighty men.

ahohite.title: Ahohite
ahohite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahohite.note: Three of David's fighting men carry this label, marking them as descendants of Ahoah: Dodo, his son Eleazar, who was among the three mightiest, and Zalmon of the thirty.

aholibamah.title: Aholibamah
aholibamah.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
aholibamah.note: She was one of Esau's wives, the daughter of a Hivite chief, and her sons became tribal leaders among the Edomites.

ahumai.title: Ahumai
ahumai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahumai.note: He headed one of the Zorathite families, from Judah through Shobal. Nothing further is known about him.

ahuzam.title: Ahuzam
ahuzam.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahuzam.note: Ashur, who founded Tekoa, had him by his wife Naarah. He shows up only in this one listing, beside his brothers Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari.

aiah-2.title: Aiah
aiah-2.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
aiah-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

aijalon.title: Aijalon
aijalon.note: In the valley of Aijalon Joshua told the moon to stand still alongside the sun during the battle against the Amorite coalition. Later it marked the boundary of Danite and Benjamite territory.

ain.title: Ain
ain.note: Given to Simeon inside Judah's territory, and later made one of the cities handed to the Levites.

akkub.title: Akkub
akkub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
akkub.note: The name keeps turning up among the Levites, gatekeepers and temple servants who came back from exile, in Ezra and Nehemiah alike.

akkub-2.title: Akkub
akkub-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
akkub-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

alameth-3.title: Alameth
alameth-3.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

alameth.title: Alameth
alameth.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
alameth.note: This Alemeth belongs to the family lists at 1 Chronicles 8:36 and 9:42. The town of the same name and Becher's son are different entries altogether.

alameth-2.title: Alameth
alameth-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
alameth-2.note: One of 3 men called Alameth. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

alamoth.title: Alamoth
alamoth.note: It literally means maidens, and it turns up in the temple records and in a psalm heading, probably marking a high part.

aliah.title: Aliah
aliah.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
aliah.note: Another spelling of Alvah, one of the chiefs of Edom descended from Esau. The two Edomite lists in Genesis and Chronicles differ in small ways like this throughout, and nothing further is recorded of him.

allon.title: Allon
allon.note: A Simeonite in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles 4:37. His line was the clan that drove the descendants of Ham out of the valley of Gedor in Hezekiah's day.

almodad.title: Almodad
almodad.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
almodad.note: First of Joktan's sons in the Table of Nations. His descendants are usually put somewhere in the Arabian peninsula, though which tribe has not been settled.

amal.title: Amal
amal.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amal.note: A son of Helem, in Asher's line at 1 Chronicles 7:35.

amalek.title: Amalek
amalek.note: Esau's grandson. The Amalekites who came from him attacked the weak rear of Israel's column in the wilderness, and God declared war on Amalek for it. Saul's half-done obedience against them later cost him the kingdom.

amariah-2.title: Amariah
amariah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amariah-2.note: A levite from the wilderness years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

amariah-3.title: Amariah
amariah-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amariah-3.note: One of 9 men called Amariah. This one is a priest from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Ezra.

amariah-4.title: Amariah
amariah-4.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
amariah-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a priest from the united kingdom.

amasa.title: Amasa
amasa.about: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
amasa.note: David's nephew. He led Absalom's rebel army, and afterwards David offered him command of the whole royal army to win back Absalom's supporters. Joab, jealous, stabbed him while pretending to greet him with a kiss.

amasai.title: Amasai
amasai.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amasai.note: Named twice in the Levitical genealogy of 1 Chronicles 6, and nothing else about him is told in those verses.

amasai-3.title: Amasai
amasai-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amasai-3.note: One of 4 men called Amasai. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

amasai-2.title: Amasai
amasai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amasai-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

amaziah.title: Amaziah
amaziah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amaziah.note: He took Judah's throne after his father Joash was assassinated and executed the killers but spared their children, as the law said. Then he beat Edom, brought its idols home and worshipped them. A war he picked with northern Israel ended with him captured and Jerusalem's walls torn down.

amaziah-4.title: Amaziah
amaziah-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amaziah-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

amaziah-3.title: Amaziah
amaziah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amaziah-3.note: One of 4 men called Amaziah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ammiel-2.title: Ammiel
ammiel-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
ammiel-2.note: One of 3 men called Ammiel. This one is a Levite from the united kingdom, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ammiel.title: Ammiel
ammiel.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ammiel.note: 1 Chronicles 3:5 makes an Ammiel the father of Bathsheba, called Bath-shua there. The name also turns up in 2 Samuel 9 and 17, given only as a father's name.

ammihud.title: Ammihud
ammihud.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ammihud.note: Father of Ephraim's tribal leader during the wilderness census.

ammihud-2.title: Ammihud
ammihud-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ammihud-2.note: A man from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

amminadab-2.title: Amminadab
amminadab-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amminadab-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

amminadab.title: Amminadab
amminadab.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amminadab.note: Two great lines run back to him. Aaron married his daughter Elisheba, and his son Nahshon stands in David's ancestry, so he sits in both the priestly and the royal genealogies.

ammizabad.title: Ammizabad
ammizabad.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ammizabad.note: Benaiah commanded the third division of David's army, and his son Ammizabad appears to have run it on his behalf.

ammon.title: Ammon
ammon.note: A nation east of the Jordan, descended from Lot through his younger daughter and close kin to Moab. The Ammonites fought Israel again and again, from Jephthah's war in Judges to the insult to David's envoys that started a full war in David's reign.

amnon.title: Amnon
amnon.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
amnon.note: David's firstborn. He raped his half-sister Tamar, with a cousin's scheme to help him, and David did not punish him. Two years later her full brother Absalom had Amnon murdered, and that was the start of the road to Absalom's revolt.

amnon-2.title: Amnon
amnon-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amnon-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

amon.title: Amon
amon.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amon.note: The son of Manasseh. He followed his father's early idolatry and never turned back, and his own officials killed him after two years. The people executed the plotters and made his young son Josiah king.

amorite.title: Amorite
amorite.note: One of the peoples in Canaan before Israel came, traced in Genesis 10 to a son of Canaan, and sometimes used loosely for everyone in the hill country. Sihon and Og ruled an Amorite kingdom east of the Jordan that fell to Israel under Moses. Outside the Bible they are the Amurru of Mesopotamian texts, the people whose dynasty produced Hammurabi of Babylon.

amram.title: Amram
amram.about: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amram.note: The father of Aaron, Moses and Miriam. He was a Levite and married his father's sister Jochebed, and beyond that little is recorded about him.

amramite.title: Amramite
amramite.about: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amramite.note: Descendants of Amram, the son of Kohath and father of Moses, Aaron and Miriam. Under David, men of this family helped oversee the treasuries of gifts dedicated for the temple.

amran.title: Amran
amran.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
amran.note: Dishon's son, among the clan chiefs of Edom before Israel had a king, and called Hemdan in Genesis 36:26.

amzi.title: Amzi
amzi.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amzi.note: A Levite, and an ancestor of Ethan, one of the temple musicians David appointed.

anah.title: Anah
anah.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
anah.note: He found hot springs in the wilderness while pasturing his father's donkeys, and he sits in the Edomite genealogies of Esau's line.

anamim.title: Anamim
anamim.note: Not a person. The Table of Nations counts them among the groups descended from Mizraim, Egypt, and which real people is meant has not been identified with confidence.

anani.title: Anani
anani.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
anani.note: Seventh of Elioenai's seven sons, at the very end of David's royal line in 1 Chronicles 3:24, generations after the return from Babylonian exile. The list shows David's family still going long after the monarchy was gone.

anathoth.title: Anathoth
anathoth.note: A priestly town in Benjamin, about three miles north of Jerusalem, and Jeremiah's home. He bought a field there as a sign of hope while announcing Jerusalem's fall. The site is identified with the village of Anata.

anathoth-2.title: Anathoth
anathoth-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
anathoth-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

anem.title: Anem
anem.note: Levites lived in this town in Issachar. It is generally identified with En-gannim, whose name survives in the modern city of Jenin.

aniam.title: Aniam
aniam.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aniam.note: A son of Shemida, in Manasseh's genealogy.

antothijah.title: Antothijah
antothijah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
antothijah.note: One of Jeroham's sons, a Benjamite head of a family living in Jerusalem. The name is related to Anathoth, which hints at a family tie to that town, and nothing further is recorded of him.

anub.title: Anub
anub.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
anub.note: Coz's son, in Judah's genealogy, from the line of Ashhur who founded Tekoa.

appaim.title: Appaim
appaim.note: Nadab's son, in the Jerahmeelite branch of Judah, and his line ran on through his son Ishi. Nothing further is recorded of him.

ara.title: Ara
ara.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ara.note: Jether's son, and head of an Asherite family. Nothing else is recorded about him.

arad-2.title: Arad
arad-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
arad-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

arah-2.title: Arah
arah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
arah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

aram-2.title: Aram
aram-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
aram-2.note: One of 3 men called Aram. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

aram.title: Aram
aram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
aram.note: It is what the Old Testament calls Syria, the region and people centred on Damascus. Under kings like Ben-hadad and Hazael it fought both Israelite kingdoms again and again.

aram-naharaim.title: Aram-naharaim
aram-naharaim.note: Aram of the two rivers, upper Mesopotamia. Abraham's relatives settled there, and the wives of Isaac and Jacob came from it.

aran.title: Aran
aran.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
aran.note: A descendant of Seir the Horite, among the clan chiefs of Edom. The Horites were the cave-dwelling people of Mount Seir before the Edomites pushed them out, and lists like this keep their tribal structure. Nothing else about him is recorded.

arbahite.title: Arbahite
arbahite.note: It marks Abi-albon, one of David's mighty men, as a man of Beth-arabah, a town in the Arabah plain near the Dead Sea.

archi.title: Archi
archi.note: Hushai's clan. He was the loyal friend of David who worked against Ahithophel's advice during Absalom's rebellion.

ardon.title: Ardon
ardon.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ardon.note: Youngest of Caleb's three sons by his first wife Azubah.

arkite.title: Arkite
arkite.note: Descendants of Canaan who lived at Arka, about twelve miles northeast of Tripoli in modern Lebanon. The site is Tell Arqa, and it appears as Irqata in the Amarna letters.

arnan.title: Arnan
arnan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
arnan.note: One more name in Zerubbabel's line after the exile, at 1 Chronicles 3:21. Nothing further is recorded about him.

aroer-2.title: Aroer
aroer-2.note: A second town of the name, in Numbers 32:34 and Joshua 13:25, on the same border between Israel's lands east of the Jordan and Ammonite territory.

aroerite.title: Aroerite
aroerite.note: Hothan, father of two of David's mighty men, Shama and Jehiel, came from Aroer. Most likely that means the town on the Arnon gorge rather than the one near Beersheba.

arphaxad.title: Arphaxad
arphaxad.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
arphaxad.note: Shem's son, born two years after the flood. Genesis runs his descendants down through several generations to Abraham, so he is the link between Noah and the patriarchs.

arvadite.title: Arvadite
arvadite.note: The people of Arvad, an island city off the Phoenician coast now called Arwad, descended from Canaan. Assyrian records show it paying tribute to Tiglath-Pileser III and Sennacherib.

asa.title: Asa
asa.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asa.note: King of Judah for forty-one years, and a real reformer. He removed his own grandmother as queen mother over an obscene idol and drove the male shrine prostitutes out. Early on he trusted God against a huge Cushite invasion, but late in life he hired a foreign king against northern Israel instead.

asa-2.title: Asa
asa-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
asa-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

asahel.title: Asahel
asahel.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
asahel.note: Joab's younger brother, one of David's best warriors and famous for his speed. He died chasing Abner in the fighting between David's side and Saul's. Joab later murdered Abner for it, and that killing hung over David's reign.

asaiah-4.title: Asaiah
asaiah-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaiah-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

asaiah-2.title: Asaiah
asaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

asaiah-3.title: Asaiah
asaiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaiah-3.note: One of 5 men called Asaiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

asaiah-5.title: Asaiah
asaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
asaiah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

asaph-3.title: Asaph
asaph-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
asaph-3.note: One of 4 men called Asaph. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

asaph.title: Asaph
asaph.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaph.note: A Levite David put in charge of one of the temple choirs. Twelve psalms carry his name, Psalm 50 and Psalms 73 to 83, which means either he wrote them or a guild of musicians kept his name for generations.

asareel.title: Asareel
asareel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

asarelah.title: Asarelah
asarelah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asarelah.note: One of Asaph's sons whom David appointed to prophesy with harp and cymbals. Later in the same chapter he is Jesharelah.

ashan.title: Ashan
ashan.note: A small town in Judah's lowlands, later handed to Simeon, whose share lay inside Judah. Aaron's line of Levites got it as a priestly city. Nobody has found the site.

ashbea.title: Ashbea
ashbea.note: "The house of Ashbea" is all Chronicles gives: the source of a family of linen workers in Judah. Whether that means a man or the place his descendants lived is not clear from the text.

ashbel.title: Ashbel
ashbel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ashbel.note: Benjamin's son, and his descendants made one of the clans of the tribe.

asher.title: Asher
asher.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
asher.note: Jacob's eighth son, by Leah's servant Zilpah. His tribe got a fertile coastal strip in the north, running toward Phoenicia, some of the richest land in Israel. Beyond its borders and city list little of the tribe's own history is recorded, and like Simeon it produced no judge or great hero.

ashkenaz.title: Ashkenaz
ashkenaz.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ashkenaz.note: Gomer's son and Japheth's grandson. Jeremiah later calls on a kingdom of Ashkenaz, with Ararat and Minni, to join in the destruction of Babylon.

ashriel-2.title: Ashriel
ashriel-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ashriel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

ashtaroth.title: Ashtaroth
ashtaroth.note: Ashtaroth under another spelling, the fortified capital of Og, king of Bashan, east of the Jordan. It went to the half-tribe of Manasseh and then to the Levites of Gershon. The name comes from the goddess Ashtoreth, and the site is generally put at Tell Ashtarah in the Golan.

ashterathite.title: Ashterathite
ashterathite.note: Uzzia, one of David's mighty men, came from Ashtaroth, the Bashan city that had been the capital of Og's Amorite kingdom.

ashur.title: Ashur
ashur.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ashur.note: Hezron's son, born after his father died. Chronicles remembers him as the founder of Tekoa, the town Amos later came from.

asiel.title: Asiel
asiel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asiel.note: A Simeonite ancestor several generations back from Jehu, one of the tribal leaders in 1 Chronicles 4:35. Nothing else is recorded about him.

asshur.title: Asshur
asshur.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
asshur.note: Shem's son, whose name stuck to the land and empire of Assyria on the upper Tigris. Assyria became the great power of the eighth and seventh centuries BC, deported Israel's northern tribes after Samaria fell, and kept threatening Judah.

assir.title: Assir
assir.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
assir.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the wilderness years.

assir-2.title: Assir
assir-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
assir-2.note: A descendant of Korah, in the Levite line at Exodus 6:24 and 1 Chronicles 6:22.

atarah.title: Atarah
atarah.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
atarah.note: Jerahmeel's second wife and mother of Onam.

ataroth-the-house-of-joab.title: Ataroth the house of Joab
ataroth-the-house-of-joab.note: One of the place-clans listed under Salma in Judah's genealogy, beside Bethlehem and the Netophathites. The awkward wording is probably a compound name, Atroth-beth-Joab, to tell this Ataroth from the others. Nobody has found it.

athaliah-2.title: Athaliah
athaliah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
athaliah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

attai.title: Attai
attai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
attai.note: Born into a line of Judah that ran through a marriage between an Israelite woman and her Egyptian servant.

attai-2.title: Attai
attai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
attai-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

avith.title: Avith
avith.note: The city of Hadad son of Bedad, one of the early kings of Edom before Israel had kings of its own. He beat the Midianites in the territory of Moab.

azal.title: Azal
azal.note: Zechariah says that when the Mount of Olives splits in two, the valley will run as far as Azal. The same name, as Azel, belongs to a Benjamite descendant of Saul through Jonathan, listed with his six sons in Chronicles.

azarael-6.title: Azarael
azarael-6.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azarael-6.note: Chronicles names him once, among David's musicians and officers.

azarael-2.title: Azarael
azarael-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azarael-2.note: One of several men called Azarel in Chronicles, this one in the list at 1 Chronicles 12:6.

azarael-3.title: Azarael
azarael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azarael-3.note: One of 6 men called Azarael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

azariah-10.title: Azariah
azariah-10.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azariah-10.note: One of 17 men called Azariah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

azariah-5.title: Azariah
azariah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azariah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

azariah.title: Azariah
azariah.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azariah.note: This is King Uzziah of Judah under his other name.

azariah-3.title: Azariah
azariah-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azariah-3.note: A priest in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles 6, named again at Ezra 7:3, and neither the king nor Daniel's friend.

azariah-6.title: Azariah
azariah-6.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
azariah-6.note: A priest from the united kingdom. 1 Kings and 1 Chronicles name him twice.

azaz.title: Azaz
azaz.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azaz.note: A Reubenite east of the Jordan, Bela's father. Nothing further is recorded of him.

azaziah.title: Azaziah
azaziah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azaziah.note: One of the musicians appointed under David, at 1 Chronicles 15:21.

azaziah-2.title: Azaziah
azaziah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azaziah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

azem.title: Azem
azem.note: Also Ezem, a town in the far south of Judah later given to Simeon. Its site in the Negev has not been identified with confidence.

aziel.title: Aziel
aziel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
aziel.note: He played the psaltery when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem. The name seems to be short for Jaaziel, two verses earlier in the same list.

azmaveth-2.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azmaveth-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

azmaveth-3.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azmaveth-3.note: One of 4 men called Azmaveth. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

azmaveth-4.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azmaveth-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

azmaveth.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
azmaveth.note: He fought for David and made the list of David's thirty. The same name belonged to a town near Jerusalem and to several other men. His own record is a line in each of the two lists of the thirty.

azriel.title: Azriel
azriel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azriel.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

azriel-2.title: Azriel
azriel-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azriel-2.note: A tribal leader of Manasseh, named once in Chronicles.

azrikam-2.title: Azrikam
azrikam-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
azrikam-2.note: He was a palace official, killed alongside King Ahaz's son when the invasion came.

azrikam.title: Azrikam
azrikam.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azrikam.note: One of several men with this name, this one listed twice in the same family line, at 1 Chronicles 8:38 and again at 9:44.

azrikam-3.title: Azrikam
azrikam-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azrikam-3.note: One of 4 men called Azrikam. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

azubah.title: Azubah
azubah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azubah.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a woman from the divided-kingdom years.

baal.title: Baal
baal.about: A male deity in the Old Testament
baal.note: The Canaanite storm god, the power people believed sent the rain and made the crops grow. Worshipping him was the temptation Israel never shook, and the Old Testament fights it from the judges onward.

baal-3.title: Baal
baal-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
baal-3.note: One of 3 men called Baal. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

baal-2.title: Baal
baal-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
baal-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

baal-hanan.title: Baal-hanan
baal-hanan.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
baal-hanan.note: An Edomite king, from the list in Genesis of rulers who reigned before Israel had a king of its own.

baal-hanan-2.title: Baal-hanan
baal-hanan-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
baal-hanan-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

baal-hermon.title: Baal-hermon
baal-hermon.note: Two things carry the name. One is a town near Mount Hermon where the half-tribe of Manasseh lived, maybe the same place as Baal-gad. The other is the mountain itself, on the list of Canaanite strongholds.

baal-meon.title: Baal-meon
baal-meon.note: It was rebuilt by Reuben, a town east of the Jordan known by several names, Beth-baal-meon and Beth-meon among them. The land around it changed hands more than once.

baal-perazim.title: Baal-perazim
baal-perazim.note: David named it, lord of breakthroughs more or less, after beating the Philistines there early in his reign over all Israel and comparing the win to floodwater breaking through.

baanah-2.title: Baanah
baanah-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
baanah-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

baara.title: Baara
baara.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
baara.note: Shaharaim, a Benjamite, had wives named Hushim and Baara. He sent both away, then had more children in Moab by Hodesh. Baara is named nowhere else.

baaseiah.title: Baaseiah
baaseiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
baaseiah.note: Further back in Asaph's line, through the Kohathite branch of Levi. Asaph was David's chief musician, and this Levite is one name in the list that traces him back.

babel.title: Babel
babel.note: The plain in Shinar where people, still speaking one language after the flood, set out to build a city and a tower reaching to the heavens and make a name for themselves. God answered by confusing their language.

baharumite.title: Baharumite
baharumite.note: It tells you where a man came from. Azmaveth, one of David's mighty men, was from Bahurim, a Benjaminite village east of Jerusalem on the road to the Jordan. The parallel list in 2 Samuel 23:31 spells it Barhumite.

bakbakkar.title: Bakbakkar
bakbakkar.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
bakbakkar.note: A Levite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile, apparently of Asaph's line. Nothing further is known about him.

balaam.title: Balaam
balaam.about: Prophet living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
balaam.note: A prophet, but not an Israelite. Balak of Moab hired him to curse the Israelites. On the way his donkey saw an angel blocking the road that Balaam himself missed, and God made the animal speak to rebuke him.

bani-3.title: Bani
bani-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bani-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

bariah.title: Bariah
bariah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bariah.note: One of five sons of Shemaiah, in the line of David after the exile. Nothing further is known of him.

bashan.title: Bashan
bashan.note: The fertile tableland east of the Jordan, between Gilead and Mount Hermon. Og ruled it, the last of the Rephaim, until Israel beat him and gave the land to half the tribe of Manasseh.

bath-shua.title: Bath-shua
bath-shua.about: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy
bath-shua.note: Daughter of Shua. Chronicles uses the phrase for two different women, and here it names the Canaanite wife of Judah, the mother of Er, Onan and Shelah.

bealiah.title: Bealiah
bealiah.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bealiah.note: He was a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag while David was still on the run from Saul. He was one of the skilled warriors who could use bow and sling with either hand.

becher.title: Becher
becher.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
becher.note: Benjamin's son, whose descendants became one of the clans of Benjamin's tribe.

bedad.title: Bedad
bedad.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
bedad.note: Hadad's father. Hadad was one of the early kings of Edom, and he beat the Midianites in the territory of Moab. Nothing else is recorded of Bedad.

bedan.title: Bedan
bedan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bedan.note: Samuel names him in his farewell speech among Israel's deliverers, with Jerubbaal, Barak and Jephthah. No judge called Bedan appears in the book of Judges, so who he was is uncertain.

beeliada.title: Beeliada
beeliada.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
beeliada.note: David's son, born in Jerusalem. The other lists call him Eliada, and Beeliada looks like the earlier form of the name, later avoided.

beer-shebah.title: Beer-shebah
beer-shebah.note: From Dan to Beersheba meant all of Israel, top to bottom, and this was the bottom. It marked the southern edge of Judah's land and went first to Simeon. Genesis gives two separate stories for how it got its name.

beera.title: Beera
beera.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
beera.note: Descended from Asher through Zophah, he is named among the heads of households in 1 Chronicles 7:37.

beerah.title: Beerah
beerah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
beerah.note: A chief of Reuben carried off into exile by the Assyrian king Tiglath-pileser III, in the eighth-century deportation that emptied out Israel's Transjordan territories.

bela-2.title: Bela
bela-2.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
bela-2.note: An early king, first on the Genesis 36 list, from long before Israel had a throne.

bela-3.title: Bela
bela-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bela-3.note: One of 3 men called Bela. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

bela.title: Bela
bela.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
bela.note: Two things go by this name in these verses. Bela, also called Zoar, was the one city of the plain spared, kept so Lot had somewhere near to run. The name also belongs to Benjamin's firstborn son.

ben.title: Ben
ben.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ben.note: He was one of the gatekeepers David put over the ark of the covenant, in the list at 1 Chronicles 15:18. He does not reappear in the parallel list a few verses on.

ben-hanan.title: Ben-hanan
ben-hanan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ben-hanan.note: Shimon's son, in the genealogy of Judah, and nothing more.

ben-zoketh.title: Ben-zoketh
ben-zoketh.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ben-zoketh.note: A Judahite, one of Ishi's sons in 1 Chronicles 4:20, in a short genealogical note the text never explains.

benaiah-5.title: Benaiah
benaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
benaiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

benaiah-6.title: Benaiah
benaiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
benaiah-6.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

benaiah-2.title: Benaiah
benaiah-2.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
benaiah-2.note: A singer from David's time, listed among the musicians in 1 Chronicles 15 and 16. The Benaiah who led David's bodyguard is another man.

benaiah.title: Benaiah
benaiah.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
benaiah.note: He commanded David's bodyguard, and before that he was known for killing a lion in a pit on a snowy day. He also beat an Egyptian giant by wrestling the giant's own spear off him and killing him with it.

benaiah-3.title: Benaiah
benaiah-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
benaiah-3.note: Not the captain of the bodyguard but another of David's warriors with the same name. He turns up in 2 Samuel 23:30 and twice in Chronicles.

benjamin.title: Benjamin
benjamin.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
benjamin.note: Jacob's twelfth son and the youngest, born to Rachel on the road near Bethlehem as she died giving birth to him. Jacob guarded him fiercely after losing Joseph. That fear drives much of the tension in Joseph's story.

benjamin-2.title: Benjamin
benjamin-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
benjamin-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

beor-2.title: Beor
beor-2.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
beor-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

berachah.title: Berachah
berachah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
berachah.note: It means blessing. This Berachah was a Benjamite warrior, one of Saul's kinsmen, who joined David at Ziklag. A Valley of Berachah near Tekoa has nothing to do with him.

berachiah.title: Berachiah
berachiah.about: Asaph's father living at the time of Divided Monarchy
berachiah.note: Asaph's father. Chronicles names him in the family line at 1 Chronicles 6:39 and twice more in chapter 15.

berachiah-5.title: Berachiah
berachiah-5.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
berachiah-5.note: A levite from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

berachiah-4.title: Berachiah
berachiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
berachiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

beraiah.title: Beraiah
beraiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
beraiah.note: Shimhi's son, and a chief man among the Benjaminite families living in Jerusalem.

bered.title: Bered
bered.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
bered.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

beri.title: Beri
beri.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
beri.note: Zophah's son, among the family heads of Asher. Nothing further is known about him.

beriah-2.title: Beriah
beriah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beriah-2.note: One of 4 men called Beriah. This one is a Levite from the wilderness years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

beriah.title: Beriah
beriah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beriah.note: A son of Asher, and the head of a clan in the Numbers 26 census. Several other men carry the same name.

beriah-3.title: Beriah
beriah-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beriah-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

beriah-4.title: Beriah
beriah-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beriah-4.note: A man from the wilderness years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

berothite.title: Berothite
berothite.note: It tells you Naharai, Joab's armor-bearer and one of David's mighty men, came from Beeroth, a Gibeonite city allotted to Benjamin.

beth-el.title: Beth-el
beth-el.note: About ten miles north of Jerusalem, and once the Canaanite city of Luz. Abram built an altar there. Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven there and called the place house of God.

beth-gader.title: Beth-gader
beth-gader.note: House of the wall. Caleb's genealogy lists it as though it were a son of Hareph, but like several names there it almost certainly means a town.

beth-horon.title: Beth-horon
beth-horon.note: Twin towns on the pass from the coastal plain up into the hill country. Joshua's army came this way chasing the Canaanite coalition in the battle where the sun stood still.

beth-rapha.title: Beth-rapha
beth-rapha.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
beth-rapha.note: Eshton's son, in the line from Chelub in the genealogy of Judah.

beth-shean.title: Beth-shean
beth-shean.note: After Saul died on Gilboa, the Philistines hung his body and his sons' bodies on the walls of this city. Beth-shean was Canaanite, in Manasseh's land. It stood where the Jezreel and Jordan valleys meet.

beth-shemesh.title: Beth-shemesh
beth-shemesh.note: It was a Levitical city on Judah's northern border, its name meaning house of the sun. When the Philistines sent the ark back, it came here first and was welcomed with sacrifice.

beth-zur.title: Beth-zur
beth-zur.note: A fortified town in the hill country of Judah, a few miles north of Hebron. Rehoboam strengthened it as part of the defences of his kingdom once the ten northern tribes had broken away.

bethbirei.title: Bethbirei
bethbirei.note: A town of Simeon's in the far south of Judah, the same place Joshua 19:6 gives as Beth-lebaoth.

bethel.title: Bethel
bethel.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

bethlehem.title: Bethlehem
bethlehem.note: House of bread. It is a small town about five miles south of Jerusalem, earlier called Ephrath, where Rachel died and was buried and where Ruth gleaned in Boaz's fields. David was born there and anointed there.

bethmarcaboth.title: Bethmarcaboth
bethmarcaboth.note: House of the chariots, a town of Simeon's in the far south of Judah. Where Joshua 15:31 lists Judah's towns, Madmannah stands in its place.

bezaleel.title: Bezaleel
bezaleel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
bezaleel.note: God named him and filled him with his Spirit to design and build the tabernacle and everything in it, the ark of the covenant included. He is the first person in the Bible described as filled with the Spirit.

bezer.title: Bezer
bezer.note: A city of refuge for Reuben, east of the Jordan. Anyone who killed a person by accident could run there for protection. It was one of three such cities on that side of the river.

bezer-2.title: Bezer
bezer-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bezer-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

bilgah-2.title: Bilgah
bilgah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bilgah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

bilhah-2.title: Bilhah
bilhah-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

bilhah.title: Bilhah
bilhah.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
bilhah.note: Rachel's maidservant. Laban had given her to Rachel, and when Rachel had no children she gave Bilhah to Jacob as a wife. Bilhah bore him Dan and Naphtali.

bilhan.title: Bilhan
bilhan.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
bilhan.note: A Horite clan chief, in Edom's genealogies.

bilhan-2.title: Bilhan
bilhan-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bilhan-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

bimhal.title: Bimhal
bimhal.note: Japhlet's son, in Asher's genealogy, and that is the only place he appears.

binea.title: Binea
binea.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
binea.note: Saul's line ran down through Jonathan and Mephibosheth to Binea, and Chronicles keeps his name in the genealogy of Benjamin.

birzaith.title: Birzaith
birzaith.about: Man or town at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
birzaith.note: In Asher's genealogy he is a descendant of Malchiel. Some translations read the Hebrew as a place name instead, and nobody has settled which it is.

bithiah.title: Bithiah
bithiah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bithiah.note: Pharaoh's daughter, married to Mered, a man of Judah. Her name means daughter of the LORD. That suggests she was seen as a convert to Israel's faith.

boaz.title: Boaz
boaz.note: A wealthy landowner in Bethlehem, related to Naomi's dead husband Elimelech. He noticed Ruth, the widowed Moabite, gleaning behind his harvesters, and he agreed to act as kinsman-redeemer.

bocheru.title: Bocheru
bocheru.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bocheru.note: Azel's son, from Saul's family through Jonathan, kept in the genealogies of Benjamin.

bozrah.title: Bozrah
bozrah.note: Edom's capital, the city of the early Edomite king Jobab. The prophets kept coming back to it in their oracles against Edom. Isaiah pictures the Lord coming from Bozrah in stained garments.

bukki.title: Bukki
bukki.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bukki.note: A priest in the high priestly line from Aaron to Zadok, named in 1 Chronicles 6 and again in Ezra's own ancestry at Ezra 7:4.

bukkiah.title: Bukkiah
bukkiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bukkiah.note: Heman's son, a Kohathite Levite. He led one of the divisions of temple musicians set up under David.

bunah.title: Bunah
bunah.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
bunah.note: Jerahmeel's son, in Judah's line through Pharez. Nothing else is recorded of him.

buz.title: Buz
buz.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
buz.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

cainan.title: Cainan
cainan.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
cainan.note: Two men in the genealogies. One descends from Seth several generations before Noah; the other is a son of Arphaxad in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, a name missing from the Genesis Hebrew text but present in the Greek.

calcol.title: Calcol
calcol.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the years before the monarchy.

caleb.title: Caleb
caleb.about: Joshua's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
caleb.note: One of the twelve spies Moses sent into Canaan. He and Joshua were the only two who came back telling Israel to trust God and take the land, and the rest of that generation paid for ignoring them with forty years in the wilderness.

caleb-2.title: Caleb
caleb-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
caleb-2.note: Not the spy. This Caleb heads his own branch of the family lines in 1 Chronicles 2, with wives and sons listed at 2:18–19 and again from 2:42.

caleb-ephrathah.title: Caleb-ephrathah
caleb-ephrathah.note: The Hebrew of 1 Chronicles 2:24 is hard, and some translations do not read Caleb-ephrathah as a single place at all. It turns up in connection with Hezron's clan and the district of Ephrathah near Bethlehem.

canaan.title: Canaan
canaan.note: The land promised to Abraham and his descendants, roughly modern Israel and the land around it. The conquest under Joshua is that promise, centuries old by then, being kept.

canaan-2.title: Canaan
canaan-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
canaan-2.note: The person, not the land. In Genesis 9 he is the son on whom the curse falls, and the people of the land would trace back to him.

canan.title: Canan
canan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
canan.note: A variant of Hanan, here one of the names in the family line at 1 Chronicles 8:38 and again at 9:44.

canan-5.title: Canan
canan-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
canan-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

canan-4.title: Canan
canan-4.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
canan-4.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

carmelite.title: Carmelite
carmelite.note: Here it means someone from Carmel in Judah's hill country, not Mount Carmel in the north. Nabal was a Carmelite, the rich fool who insulted David, and so was his wife Abigail, who married David after Nabal died.

carmi.title: Carmi
carmi.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
carmi.note: Reuben's son, whose family became one of the tribe's clans.

carmi-2.title: Carmi
carmi-2.note: Achan's father. Achan took plunder from Jericho that was devoted to God, and Israel lost its next battle because of it.

casluhim.title: Casluhim
casluhim.note: A people, not a person. They descend from Mizraim, the ancestor of Egypt, in the Table of Nations, and Genesis says the Philistines came from them.

chelub.title: Chelub
chelub.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chelub.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

chelub-2.title: Chelub
chelub-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chelub-2.note: Shuhah's brother and Mehir's father, in the tribe of Judah.

chelubai.title: Chelubai
chelubai.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
chelubai.note: Hezron's son, also called Caleb, and the head of a branch of Judah's family tree in Chronicles. He is a different man from Caleb son of Jephunneh, the spy who went into Canaan with Joshua.

chenaanah-2.title: Chenaanah
chenaanah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chenaanah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

chenaniah.title: Chenaniah
chenaniah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chenaniah.note: David put this Levite in charge of the music when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem, because he was good at it.

cheran.title: Cheran
cheran.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
cheran.note: Dishon's son, from the Horite clans of Seir. The Horites lived in the region before Edom's kings arose and were later pushed out or absorbed.

cherethims.title: Cherethims
cherethims.about: A military group in the Old Testament
cherethims.note: David's bodyguard, with the Pelethites, under Benaiah's command. They were tied closely to the Philistines and likely came from Crete.

chesulloth.title: Chesulloth
chesulloth.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

chidon.title: Chidon
chidon.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
chidon.note: The threshing floor where Uzzah put his hand on the ark and died, on the road toward Jerusalem; 2 Samuel calls the same spot Nachon's threshing floor.

chileab.title: Chileab
chileab.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
chileab.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

chittim-2.title: Chittim
chittim-2.note: Named twice, in Genesis and 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

choseba.title: Choseba
choseba.note: One terse line in 1 Chronicles about men of Judah's line who had authority in Moab. It may be the same place as Achzib or Chezib, Shelah's birthplace, but the wording is too thin to be sure.

chun.title: Chun
chun.note: David took bronze from this city of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, and the bronze later went into Solomon's temple. 2 Samuel calls it Berothai. It probably lay somewhere in the Beqaa Valley of Lebanon.

chush-2.title: Chush
chush-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
chush-2.note: Ham's eldest son, whose descendants are tied to the country south of Egypt that carries his name.

dabareh.title: Dabareh
dabareh.note: Also called Daberath, on Zebulun's border near Mount Tabor, and later given to the Gershonite Levites. The Arab village of Deburiyeh at the western foot of Tabor still carries the name.

dagon.title: Dagon
dagon.about: A male deity in the Old Testament
dagon.note: The Philistines set the captured ark in Dagon's temple at Ashdod. His statue was found face down before the ark, and the second time it had lost its head and hands.

dalaiah-3.title: Dalaiah
dalaiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
dalaiah-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

dalaiah-4.title: Dalaiah
dalaiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
dalaiah-4.note: One of 5 men called Dalaiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

dan.title: Dan
dan.note: The tribe of Dan and the town it took. Squeezed in its first allotment near the Philistines, the tribe went north, captured Laish and renamed it Dan, Israel's northernmost town and the far end of from Dan to Beersheba. Jeroboam I put one of his golden calves there, and a stele from Tel Dan found in 1993 names the House of David.

dan-2.title: Dan
dan-2.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
dan-2.note: Jacob's son by Bilhah, Rachel's servant, and the ancestor of the tribe that carries his name.

dara.title: Dara
dara.note: Probably the same man as Darda, a son of Zerah. He is one of the wise men, with Heman, Chalcol and Ethan, whose wisdom Solomon's outdid.

david.title: David
david.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
david.note: The shepherd from Bethlehem who killed Goliath and became Israel's second king, ruling a kingdom bigger than any native king held before or after. Solomon was one of his sons. Nearly half the psalms carry his name, and the Tel Dan inscription, where an enemy king boasts over the house of David, put his dynasty outside the Bible as well.

debir.title: Debir
debir.note: Othniel took this town in Judah's hill country and won Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife for it. Debir is also the name of a Canaanite king Joshua defeated.

dedan-2.title: Dedan
dedan-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
dedan-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

dedan-3.title: Dedan
dedan-3.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
dedan-3.note: One of 3 men called Dedan. This one is a man from the patriarchs, named twice in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

diklah.title: Diklah
diklah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
diklah.note: A son of Joktan in the table of nations, more likely a tribal territory than one man. The name means palm grove, which points to a date-growing district of Arabia, but where is uncertain.

dinhaban.title: Dinhaban
dinhaban.note: A place, not a person, and a variant spelling of Dinhabah, the capital of Bela son of Beor, first on Edom's list of early kings. It lay somewhere south and east of the Dead Sea; the site is unknown.

dishan.title: Dishan
dishan.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
dishan.note: Youngest of the sons of Seir, a Horite chief among Edom's earlier people.

dishon.title: Dishon
dishon.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
dishon.note: One of the Horite chiefs who held Edom's land before Esau's descendants settled it.

dodai.title: Dodai
dodai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
dodai.note: An Ahohite who led David's army division in the second month, one of twelve divisions that took turns. He may be the father of Eleazar, one of David's three chief warriors.

dodo.title: Dodo
dodo.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
dodo.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

dodo-2.title: Dodo
dodo-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
dodo-2.note: Father of one of David's mighty men, named only so that his son can be.

dor.title: Dor
dor.note: A royal Canaanite port on the coast south of Mount Carmel. Joshua beat its king, but its people were never fully driven out, and it later went into one of Solomon's districts. Excavation at Tel Dor traces the shift from Canaanite to Phoenician on that coast.

dumah.title: Dumah
dumah.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
dumah.note: A son of Ishmael, and the Arabian tribe and region that came from him, usually tied to the oasis of Dumat al-Jandal.

ebal.title: Ebal
ebal.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
ebal.note: The mountain of the curses, opposite Mount Gerizim near Shechem. Moses ordered six tribes onto Ebal to speak the covenant's curses while six on Gerizim spoke its blessings, and Joshua built an altar there and wrote the law on stones. A Horite chief descended from Seir carried the name too.

eber-2.title: Eber
eber-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eber-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

eber-3.title: Eber
eber-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eber-3.note: One of 5 men called Eber. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

eber-4.title: Eber
eber-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eber-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

eber.title: Eber
eber.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
eber.note: Several generations before Abraham in Shem's line, and his name is the likely source of the word Hebrew.

ebiasaph.title: Ebiasaph
ebiasaph.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ebiasaph.note: A Levite in Korah's line, among the descendants who stayed in temple service after their ancestor's revolt.

edar.title: Edar
edar.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
edar.note: A Levite, named twice in the Levite rolls of 1 Chronicles 23 and 24. The tower of Eder near Bethlehem, where Jacob camped after Rachel died, shares the name and nothing more.

edom.title: Edom
edom.note: Esau got the byname Edom over a bowl of red stew, and it stuck to the mountain country his descendants settled southeast of the Dead Sea. Bozrah was its old capital and Sela, the Greeks' Petra, its rock fortress. Edom refused Israel passage in the exodus and later helped Babylon sack Jerusalem, and the prophets did not let that go.

eglah.title: Eglah
eglah.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
eglah.note: One of David's wives in his Hebron years, mother of Ithream. She appears only in those two lists.

egypt.title: Egypt
egypt.note: Joseph rose to power there and kept his family alive through the famine. A later pharaoh enslaved their descendants, and that set up the exodus. For the rest of the Old Testament Egypt stands for the slavery Israel was brought out of, and Matthew has Jesus's family flee there from Herod as if living that story again.

egypt-2.title: Egypt
egypt-2.note: Named 5 times, in 1 Chronicles and Psalm, and nowhere else.

egypt-3.title: Egypt
egypt-3.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
egypt-3.note: In Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1 Egypt is a person, one of the fathers in the list of nations.

ehud.title: Ehud
ehud.note: A left-handed judge from the tribe of Benjamin. He strapped a dagger to his right thigh, where nobody checks a right-handed man, killed the fat Moabite king Eglon, and locked the doors behind him on the way out. Israel then routed the Moabites and had eighty years of rest, the longest in Judges.

ehud-2.title: Ehud
ehud-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ehud-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

eker.title: Eker
eker.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eker.note: Son of Ram in Judah's line, listed with his brothers Maaz and Jamin.

eladah.title: Eladah
eladah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eladah.note: An Ephraimite in 1 Chronicles 7, an ancestor of Joshua son of Nun in that family line, and nothing further is recorded about him.

elah-3.title: Elah
elah-3.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
elah-3.note: One of 5 men called Elah. This one is a man from the patriarchs, named twice in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

elah-6.title: Elah
elah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elah-6.note: A man from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elah-5.title: Elah
elah-5.note: A man from the years before the monarchy, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elam-4.title: Elam
elam-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elam-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elam-5.title: Elam
elam-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elam-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elam-3.title: Elam
elam-3.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
elam-3.note: One of 7 men called Elam. This one is a man from the patriarchs, named twice in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

elasah.title: Elasah
elasah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elasah.note: One of the two men Zedekiah sent to Babylon, and Jeremiah gave them his letter to the exiles to carry.

eldaah.title: Eldaah
eldaah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
eldaah.note: Youngest of Midian's sons, Abraham's grandson through Keturah, and ancestor of one of the Arabian groups that came from Midian.

elead.title: Elead
elead.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elead.note: Ephraimite raiders went after the livestock of Gath and the men of Gath killed them. Elead was one of those sons, and their father Ephraim mourned many days.

eleazar.title: Eleazar
eleazar.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eleazar.note: Aaron's third son. Nadab and Abihu died for offering unauthorized fire, and Eleazar became high priest after his father. He worked with Moses on the second census and with Joshua on dividing the land, and his line held the high priesthood for most of the history after.

eleazar-2.title: Eleazar
eleazar-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eleazar-2.note: A Levite in the Chronicles lists, a different man from Aaron's son the high priest.

eleazar-3.title: Eleazar
eleazar-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
eleazar-3.note: One of 8 men called Eleazar. This one is a warrior from the united kingdom, named twice in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

eliab-2.title: Eliab
eliab-2.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
eliab-2.note: David's eldest brother. He was tall and looked the part, and Samuel thought he was the one until God told him the Lord looks at the heart. Later he tore into David for turning up at the Goliath battle line.

eliab-5.title: Eliab
eliab-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliab-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliab.title: Eliab
eliab.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eliab.note: A tribal leader in the wilderness, named in the census of Numbers 1, the camp order, the offerings of Numbers 7 and the march in Numbers 10. He is not David's brother.

eliab-4.title: Eliab
eliab-4.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliab-4.note: One of the singers and players when David brought the ark up, named in 1 Chronicles 15 and 16.

eliada.title: Eliada
eliada.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
