eliada.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem.

eliahbah.title: Eliahbah
eliahbah.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
eliahbah.note: A Shaalbonite on the roll of David's thirty mighty men. No deed of his is recorded.

eliashib-4.title: Eliashib
eliashib-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliashib-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliashib-5.title: Eliashib
eliashib-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliashib-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

eliathah.title: Eliathah
eliathah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliathah.note: A son of Heman, the Levite musician of David's court, and head of one of the divisions of temple musicians.

eliel.title: Eliel
eliel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel.note: A common name among Levitical officials and David's warriors in Chronicles. This one is named among the Levitical officials called up when the ark was brought to Jerusalem.

eliel-4.title: Eliel
eliel-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-4.note: One of 8 men called Eliel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 12:11.

eliel-6.title: Eliel
eliel-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-6.note: One of 8 men called Eliel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 8:20.

eliel-7.title: Eliel
eliel-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-7.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

eliel-2.title: Eliel
eliel-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-2.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliel-3.title: Eliel
eliel-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 1 Chronicles 11:47.

eliel-5.title: Eliel
eliel-5.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliel-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 1 Chronicles 5:24.

elienai.title: Elienai
elienai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elienai.note: One of the heads of Benjaminite families living in Jerusalem.

eliezer.title: Eliezer
eliezer.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eliezer.note: Moses's second son. The name means my God is my help, and his descendants are counted among the Levites in Chronicles.

eliezer-2.title: Eliezer
eliezer-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliezer-2.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

eliezer-3.title: Eliezer
eliezer-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliezer-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliezer-4.title: Eliezer
eliezer-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eliezer-4.note: One of 11 men called Eliezer. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

elihoenai-2.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihoenai-2.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elihoenai.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihoenai.note: A descendant of David in the royal line of 1 Chronicles 3, well after the exile.

elihoenai-4.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihoenai-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

elihoenai-5.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-5.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elihoenai-5.note: One of 8 men called Elihoenai. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

elihu-4.title: Elihu
elihu-4.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
elihu-4.note: A man from the united kingdom. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elihu-3.title: Elihu
elihu-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihu-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elihu-2.title: Elihu
elihu-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihu-2.note: One of 5 men called Elihu. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

elijah-2.title: Elijah
elijah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elijah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

eliphal.title: Eliphal
eliphal.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliphal.note: Son of Ur and one of David's mighty men in Chronicles, apparently the man 2 Samuel calls Eliphelet son of Ahasbai.

eliphalet.title: Eliphalet
eliphalet.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
eliphalet.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, a name David used more than once.

eliphalet-6.title: Eliphalet
eliphalet-6.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
eliphalet-6.note: One of 6 men called Eliphalet. This one is a man from the united kingdom, named once in 1 Chronicles.

eliphalet-2.title: Eliphalet
eliphalet-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliphalet-2.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

eliphaz.title: Eliphaz
eliphaz.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
eliphaz.note: Esau's son, the first of the Edomite line in Genesis 36, and father of a string of Edomite chiefs.

elipheleh.title: Elipheleh
elipheleh.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elipheleh.note: A Levite who played the harp on the Sheminith when David brought the ark up to Jerusalem. Nobody is sure what Sheminith means; it may be an instrument, a tuning or an octave.

elishah.title: Elishah
elishah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
elishah.note: A son of Javan, whose descendants Ezekiel ties to the fine purple dye that Tyre bought.

elishama-2.title: Elishama
elishama-2.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
elishama-2.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, in the lists of 2 Samuel 5 and 1 Chronicles 3 and 14.

elishama-5.title: Elishama
elishama-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elishama-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elishama.title: Elishama
elishama.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elishama.note: Ephraim's tribal leader in the wilderness, named at the census, in the camp order, with the offerings and on the march.

elishua.title: Elishua
elishua.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
elishua.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, and listed as Elishama in 1 Chronicles 3.

elizaphan.title: Elizaphan
elizaphan.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elizaphan.note: He led the Kohathite Levites in the wilderness. When Nadab and Abihu died for offering unauthorized fire, he was one of those who carried the bodies out.

elkanah-2.title: Elkanah
elkanah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elkanah-2.note: One of 8 men called Elkanah. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

elkanah-4.title: Elkanah
elkanah-4.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
elkanah-4.note: Exodus and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a Levite from the wilderness years.

elkanah-7.title: Elkanah
elkanah-7.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
elkanah-7.note: A levite from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elkanah.title: Elkanah
elkanah.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
elkanah.note: Samuel's father. He had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah, and loved Hannah though she had no children and Peninnah taunted her for it. That is where Hannah's prayer for a son starts.

elkanah-3.title: Elkanah
elkanah-3.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
elkanah-3.note: A levite from the united kingdom, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elkanah-6.title: Elkanah
elkanah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elkanah-6.note: One of 8 men called Elkanah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

elkanah-5.title: Elkanah
elkanah-5.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elkanah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

elkanan.title: Elkanan
elkanan.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
elkanan.note: Elhanan, a warrior in David's army. 2 Samuel credits him with killing Goliath the Gittite, and 1 Chronicles says it was Goliath's brother Lahmi, which takes the clash out of David's story.

elkanan-2.title: Elkanan
elkanan-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
elkanan-2.note: 2 Samuel credits him with killing Goliath the Gittite. 1 Chronicles says it was Goliath's brother Lahmi. That is how the two accounts are usually squared.

elnaam.title: Elnaam
elnaam.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elnaam.note: His two sons, Jeribai and Joshaviah, are on the longer roll of David's warriors in Chronicles.

elpaal.title: Elpaal
elpaal.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elpaal.note: A descendant of Benjamin whose line is credited in Chronicles with building Ono and Lod.

eluzai.title: Eluzai
eluzai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eluzai.note: A Benjamite who came over to David at Ziklag while David was still an outlaw. He was one of the fighters who could use bow and sling with either hand.

elzabad-2.title: Elzabad
elzabad-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elzabad-2.note: A son of Shemaiah, counted among the able men of his family of gatekeepers.

elzabad.title: Elzabad
elzabad.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elzabad.note: A Gadite who joined David at Ziklag before he was king, sharing the name with a Korahite gatekeeper in Chronicles.

enoch.title: Enoch
enoch.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
enoch.note: Seventh from Adam. Genesis says he walked with God, and then he was not, for God took him, with no death notice like the others. Jude quotes a prophecy in his name, and a whole later body of Jewish apocalyptic writing carries it too, though written centuries after him.

enos.title: Enos
enos.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
enos.note: Seth's son. In his days, Genesis says, people began to call on the name of the Lord.

ephah-3.title: Ephah
ephah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ephah-3.note: One of 4 men called Ephah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ephah.title: Ephah
ephah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephah.note: Midian's son and Abraham's grandson through Keturah. His people settled in northern Arabia, and Isaiah pictures the land of Ephah bringing gold and incense to Zion.

ephah-2.title: Ephah
ephah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ephah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a woman from the divided-kingdom years.

epher-2.title: Epher
epher-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
epher-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

epher.title: Epher
epher.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
epher.note: A son of Midian, named in the two lists of Midian's sons and nowhere else.

epher-3.title: Epher
epher-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
epher-3.note: One of 3 men called Epher. This one is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ephlal.title: Ephlal
ephlal.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ephlal.note: In Jerahmeel's line, the branch of Judah that ran through Jarha, a servant who married into the family.

ephraim.title: Ephraim
ephraim.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephraim.note: Joseph's younger son. When Jacob blessed the two boys he crossed his hands on purpose and gave Ephraim the bigger blessing over Manasseh. The tribe came to dominate the north so much that the prophets use Ephraim for the whole northern kingdom.

er.title: Er
er.note: Judah's firstborn. Genesis says only that he was wicked in the Lord's sight and God put him to death, and his widow Tamar's story starts from there.

er-2.title: Er
er-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

esau.title: Esau
esau.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
esau.note: Isaac and Rebekah's elder twin, born red and hairy just ahead of Jacob. He sold his birthright for a bowl of stew, and Jacob later tricked him out of the blessing too, and only after years apart did the two make up in tears. His descendants were the Edomites.

esau-2.title: Esau
esau-2.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
esau-2.note: A man from the patriarchs. Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him 7 times.

eshbaal.title: Eshbaal
eshbaal.about: Saul's son living at the time of United Monarchy
eshbaal.note: Saul's fourth son, whose name means man of Baal. 2 Samuel calls him Ish-bosheth, man of shame, because later Israel did not like Baal even inside a name. Abner made him king over the northern tribes after Saul died, and his short reign ended in murder.

eshban.title: Eshban
eshban.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
eshban.note: One of Dishon's four sons, a Horite among the clan chiefs of Seir.

eshek.title: Eshek
eshek.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eshek.note: Saul's descendant through Jonathan, in Benjamin's royal line.

eshtaulites.title: Eshtaulites
eshtaulites.note: One of the families of the Kiriath-jearim clans in Judah's genealogy, tied to the town of Eshtaol.

eshtemoa.title: Eshtemoa
eshtemoa.note: David sent some of the Amalekite plunder to the elders of Eshtemoa, a priestly town south of Hebron, for standing by him in his outlaw years. It survives as es-Samu, where old ruins have been found.

eshton.title: Eshton
eshton.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eshton.note: A descendant of Chelub in Judah's genealogy, father of Beth-rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah. The names are probably clans or towns now lost.

etam.title: Etam
etam.note: Named twice, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

ethan.title: Ethan
ethan.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ethan.note: In 1 Kings Ethan is one of the wise men Solomon outdid, and Psalm 89 is credited to Ethan the Ezrahite, possibly the same man. The name also turns up among the singers of Chronicles.

ethan-2.title: Ethan
ethan-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the years before the monarchy.

ethnan.title: Ethnan
ethnan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ethnan.note: Son of Helah, one of Ashur's wives, in the genealogy of Judah. Ashur founded Tekoa, and nothing else is known of Ethnan.

ethni.title: Ethni
ethni.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ethni.note: A Gershonite Levite in the ancestry of Asaph the musician.

euphrates.title: Euphrates
euphrates.note: The great river. It rises in the Armenian highlands and runs some seventeen hundred miles to the Persian Gulf. Genesis has it as one of Eden's four rivers, the promise to Abraham reaches to it, and later Assyria and Babylon came from beyond it.

ezbai.title: Ezbai
ezbai.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezbai.note: Father of Naarai, one of David's mighty men, and nothing further is recorded.

ezbon.title: Ezbon
ezbon.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ezbon.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

ezer.title: Ezer
ezer.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
ezer.note: A chieftain of Seir, named in Edom's early lists of clan heads.

ezer-2.title: Ezer
ezer-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezer-2.note: One of 5 men called Ezer. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ezer-3.title: Ezer
ezer-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ezer-3.note: Named once, in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles 4. The Seirite chief and the Ephraimite with the same name are other men.

ezer-4.title: Ezer
ezer-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ezer-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

ezrah.title: Ezrah
ezrah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezrah.note: Father of Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon, in a Judah genealogy that also names Mered's wives and some descendants tied to Egypt, and nothing more is recorded of Ezrah himself.

ezri.title: Ezri
ezri.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezri.note: He was Chelub's son, and David put him over the workers who farmed the royal land; that one line in Chronicles is the whole of him.

gaash.title: Gaash
gaash.note: Joshua was buried near this hill in Ephraim, close to Timnath-heres.

gaba.title: Gaba
gaba.note: Another English spelling of Geba, a Levitical city in Benjamin by the pass of Michmash. Jonathan raided a Philistine garrison there, and later it marked the line between the northern and southern kingdoms.

gad.title: Gad
gad.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
gad.note: Jacob's seventh son, born to Leah's servant Zilpah. His tribe asked for good pasture east of the Jordan and got it. The condition was that Gad's fighting men still crossed over and helped the other tribes take their land first.

gad-2.title: Gad
gad-2.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
gad-2.note: A prophet of the united monarchy, and nothing to do with Jacob's son. He first turns up in 1 Samuel 22:5, comes back in 2 Samuel 24, and Chronicles names him again.

galal.title: Galal
galal.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
galal.note: A Levite among those who settled back in Jerusalem after the exile, listed in Chronicles and Nehemiah.

galal-2.title: Galal
galal-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
galal-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

galilee.title: Galilee
galilee.note: Jesus grew up here and did most of his public work around the Sea of Galilee. Judeans thought the north provincial and mixed, which is the edge on Nathanael's question about whether anything good could come out of Nazareth.

gamul.title: Gamul
gamul.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
gamul.note: The twenty-second of the twenty-four priestly divisions David set up for the temple went by his name.

gareb.title: Gareb
gareb.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
gareb.note: One of David's mighty warriors. There is also a hill near Jerusalem called Gareb, in Jeremiah, which is a different thing entirely.

garmite.title: Garmite
garmite.about: People descended from the area of Garem(?)
garmite.note: The word is tied to Keilah in Judah's genealogy, 1 Chronicles 4:19, and what it means is uncertain. The text never explains it.

gatam.title: Gatam
gatam.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
gatam.note: Esau's grandson through Eliphaz, and one of the chiefs of Edom, the dukes of the old translations, heading a clan and otherwise only a name in the lists.

gath.title: Gath
gath.note: Goliath's hometown, one of the five Philistine cities. The captured ark brought disaster on it, David later hid there with King Achish while running from Saul, and in the end David took it. Most identify it with Tell es-Safi, where a potsherd turned up carrying two names related to Goliath.

gath-rimmon-d.title: Gath-rimmon. d
gath-rimmon-d.note: In Dan's territory, and given to the Kohathite Levites. A second Gath-rimmon shows up in the Manasseh list, but 1 Chronicles 6:70 has Bileam there instead, which looks like a copying slip rather than two towns with one name.

gazer.title: Gazer
gazer.note: The same city as Gezer. Pharaoh took it and gave it to his daughter when she married Solomon, and Solomon fortified it along with Hazor and Megiddo. The Gezer Calendar, a little tablet of farming seasons in early Hebrew script, was found there.

gazez.title: Gazez
gazez.note: Two men in one verse. One is Caleb's son by his concubine Ephah, the other is a son of Haran, Ephah's son, and so the first one's nephew. Some think the second is a scribe repeating himself, but the text as it stands has two.

gedaliah-2.title: Gedaliah
gedaliah-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
gedaliah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the united kingdom.

gederah.title: Gederah
gederah.note: It sat in the Shephelah, Judah's lowland, and Chronicles names potters of Judah's line who lived there and worked for the king.

gederathite.title: Gederathite
gederathite.note: Josabad was one, a Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag while Saul was still hunting him.

gederite.title: Gederite
gederite.note: Baal-hanan, who looked after David's olive and sycamore trees in the lowlands, is called this because he came from Geder or Gederah.

gedor.title: Gedor
gedor.note: A town in the hill country of Judah between Jerusalem and Hebron, whose founders Chronicles traces through Hur and Ephrathah. The same name belongs to another place and to a man in Saul's family.

gedor-3.title: Gedor
gedor-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and nothing else is recorded.

gedor-2.title: Gedor
gedor-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
gedor-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

gera-2.title: Gera
gera-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gera-2.note: The name ran in the Benjamite tribe. This Gera is in Genesis 46:21 and in 1 Chronicles 8:5, and Judges 3:15 makes a Gera the father of Ehud, the left-handed judge.

gera-3.title: Gera
gera-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gera-3.note: One of 4 men called Gera. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

gera-4.title: Gera
gera-4.note: A man from the years before the monarchy, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

gershom.title: Gershom
gershom.note: These verses are the census ones, Genesis 46:11, Exodus 6:16 and Numbers 3 and 4, where his family is counted and given its share of the tabernacle work. The note filed with them describes Moses's firstborn, born in Midian and named for a stranger there, who is a different man.

gershon.title: Gershon
gershon.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gershon.note: Levi's eldest son. His descendants carried the tabernacle's coverings, curtains and hangings by cart through the wilderness. Exodus 2:22 and 18:3, filed under this name, belong to a different man.

geshan.title: Geshan
geshan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
geshan.note: Caleb's line, through his son Jahdai, in the genealogy of Judah.

geshur.title: Geshur
geshur.note: It was a small Aramean kingdom northeast of Galilee, and Absalom ran there after murdering his brother Amnon and stayed three years under his grandfather the king.

gether.title: Gether
gether.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
gether.note: A son of Aram in Genesis 10:23, most likely standing for an Aramean clan rather than one ancestor, and no later trace of it has been found.

gibeah.title: Gibeah
gibeah.about: Woman or town of the time of Divided Monarchy
gibeah.note: Not Saul's Gibeah in Benjamin. This one is a Judahite settlement in 1 Chronicles 2:49, founded by a descendant of Caleb, and nothing more is recorded about it.

gibeathite.title: Gibeathite
gibeathite.note: Benjaminite archers and slingers from Gibeah, Saul's own town, who went over to David at Ziklag while he was still an outlaw.

gibeon.title: Gibeon
gibeon.note: They tricked Joshua into a treaty by dressing as travellers from far away, the Hivites of this city northwest of Jerusalem, and so they lived but served at Israel's sanctuary. The tabernacle stood at Gibeon for years, and Solomon had his dream there. At el-Jib dozens of jar handles stamped with the name have settled where it was.

gibeonite.title: Gibeonite
gibeonite.note: Saul broke the old treaty and killed some of them. Under David a famine followed, and it ended only when seven of Saul's descendants were handed over to the Gibeonites for execution.

giddalti.title: Giddalti
giddalti.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
giddalti.note: One of Heman's sons, and Heman was a Levite musician in David's court. Giddalti led one of the twenty-four divisions of temple musicians.

gilboa.title: Gilboa
gilboa.note: Saul died on these hills above the Jezreel Valley. The Philistines broke his army, three of his sons fell, Jonathan among them, and Saul, badly wounded, took his own life. David's lament curses Gilboa never to have dew or rain.

gilead.title: Gilead
gilead.note: Hill country east of the Jordan, split by the Jabbok between Og in the north and Sihon in the south before the conquest. Gad, Reuben and half of Manasseh got it, and its rough ground made it a refuge for Jacob running from Laban and David running from Absalom. Jeremiah's question about balm in Gilead comes from its trade in balm and spices.

gilead-4.title: Gilead
gilead-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
gilead-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

gilead-2.title: Gilead
gilead-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gilead-2.note: The man, not the region. Numbers 26 and Joshua 17 put him in Manasseh's family, and Chronicles lists him there again.

girgashite.title: Girgashite
girgashite.note: Descended from Canaan in Genesis 10, and one of the peoples on the list Israel was to drive out. Where exactly they lived is unclear, though they are generally placed in the central hill country.

gittite.title: Gittite
gittite.note: A man from Gath. Obed-edom the Gittite kept the ark in his house before David brought it up to Jerusalem, and Ittai the Gittite brought his foreign troops to David's side when Absalom rebelled.

gizonite.title: Gizonite
gizonite.note: Hashem, whose sons were among David's mighty men, came from Gizoh, a place in Judah's hill country otherwise unknown. In 2 Samuel 23:32 the same family is listed as Jashen.

gog-2.title: Gog
gog-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gog-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

golan.title: Golan
golan.note: One of the three cities of refuge east of the Jordan, in Bashan, where someone who had killed by accident could run from revenge. It went to the Gershonite Levites and later gave its name to the region, which is why there are Golan Heights today. The exact site is not known.

goliath.title: Goliath
goliath.about: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
goliath.note: The Philistine champion from Gath whom the young David killed in the valley of Elah. The traditional Hebrew text makes him over nine feet, while the Dead Sea Scrolls and the earliest Greek give about six foot nine. One later passage credits Elhanan, and Chronicles makes Elhanan's man Goliath's brother.

gomer.title: Gomer
gomer.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
gomer.note: Genesis 10 makes him a son of Japheth, and the name stands for his descendants too, which is how Ezekiel 38:6 can list Gomer as a nation. Hosea's wife has the same name and is a different person.

gozan.title: Gozan
gozan.note: When Assyria took the northern kingdom, it resettled Israelite captives in this region of northern Mesopotamia.

guni-2.title: Guni
guni-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
guni-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

guni.title: Guni
guni.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
guni.note: One of Naphtali's sons, and a clan of the tribe came from him.

habor.title: Habor
habor.note: After Samaria fell in 722 BC, the Assyrians deported the northern kingdom's people to this river and its district. It is the Khabur, a big tributary of the Euphrates in what is now northeastern Syria.

hachmoni.title: Hachmoni
hachmoni.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hachmoni.note: The Hachmonite family name stands behind Jashobeam, one of David's chief warriors, and Jehiel, who attended David's sons, is called his son.

hadad-3.title: Hadad
hadad-3.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadad-3.note: A son of Ishmael, in the list of Genesis 25:15. Nothing else is told of him.

hadad-2.title: Hadad
hadad-2.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadad-2.note: One of the kings of Edom, in Genesis 36 and the matching list in Chronicles. The name was common among them.

hadad-4.title: Hadad
hadad-4.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadad-4.note: One of 3 men called Hadad. This one is a king from the patriarchs, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hadadezer.title: Hadadezer
hadadezer.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
hadadezer.note: David fought this Aramean king in campaign after campaign, and the wins pushed Israel's borders out and brought in tribute and a great deal of captured bronze.

hadoram.title: Hadoram
hadoram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadoram.note: Genesis 10:27 makes him one of Joktan's sons. Under the same name Chronicles has a prince sent to congratulate David on a victory, and the official over Solomon's forced labour who was stoned to death when the kingdom split under Rehoboam.

hagarene.title: Hagarene
hagarene.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hagarene.note: They were nomads east of Gilead, beaten by Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh in a war Chronicles records.

haggiah.title: Haggiah
haggiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
haggiah.note: A Merarite Levite, in the line of Levi's descendants who served in the temple.

haggith.title: Haggith
haggith.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
haggith.note: She was one of David's wives and Adonijah's mother, and her son tried to take the throne while David was dying.

halah.title: Halah
halah.note: A district in Assyria, probably near Nineveh, where Israelites were deported after Samaria fell. Sargon II boasts in his own inscriptions of taking tens of thousands from Samaria around 722 BC.

ham.title: Ham
ham.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ham.note: Noah's son. He saw his father drunk and naked in the tent and told his brothers instead of covering him, and when Noah woke he cursed Ham's son Canaan, not Ham. Egypt and Cush are among the peoples Genesis 10 traces to him.

hamath.title: Hamath
hamath.note: An Aramean capital on the Orontes in Upper Syria, the old northern limit of the land promised to Israel. Its king Toi was David's ally. Inscribed stones from the site, set up by a king the Assyrians called Irhuleni, were among the first Hieroglyphic Luwian texts European scholars saw, and reading his name gave them some of the script's first sign values.

hamathite.title: Hamathite
hamathite.note: The people of Hamath, counted among Canaan's descendants. Their city on the Orontes kept marking Israel's northern border, and Assyrian records put its king Irhuleni beside Ahab against Shalmaneser III at Qarqar in 853 BC.

hammath.title: Hammath
hammath.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hammath.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hammoleketh.title: Hammoleketh
hammoleketh.note: Gilead's sister, from Manasseh, and the mother of Abiezer, Ishod and Mahalah. Her name means the queen, and nothing else is recorded about her.

hammon.title: Hammon
hammon.note: Two towns. One was in Asher near Sidon, probably Umm el-Amoud, and the other a Levitical city in Naphtali, likely Hammath by the Sea of Galilee.

hamuel.title: Hamuel
hamuel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hamuel.note: Simeonite, among Shaul's descendants in 1 Chronicles 4:26. No other information about him survives.

hamul.title: Hamul
hamul.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hamul.note: Perez's son and Judah's grandson. One of Judah's clans came from him.

hanani-2.title: Hanani
hanani-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hanani-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

hananiah-3.title: Hananiah
hananiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hananiah-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

hananiah-4.title: Hananiah
hananiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hananiah-4.note: One of 15 men called Hananiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hananiah-5.title: Hananiah
hananiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hananiah-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

hanniel.title: Hanniel
hanniel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hanniel.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hanun.title: Hanun
hanun.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
hanun.note: David sent men to comfort him when his father died, and the Ammonite king shaved off half their beards and cut their clothes short. It started a full war between Israel and Ammon with its Aramean allies.

happizzez.title: Happizzez
happizzez.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
happizzez.note: Head of the eighteenth of the twenty-four priestly divisions, chosen by lot. Some English versions spell it Aphses, and nothing else is recorded of him.

hara.title: Hara
hara.note: Members of Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh were deported here by the Assyrians. It seems to have lain along the Khabur River, and Tiglath-pileser III's own annals record the deportation.

haran-4.title: Haran
haran-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
haran-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

haran-3.title: Haran
haran-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
haran-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

hararite.title: Hararite
hararite.note: Roughly, the mountaineer. Three of David's mighty men carry it, among them Shammah son of Agee, who held a field of lentils against a Philistine raid on his own.

hareph.title: Hareph
hareph.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hareph.note: A son of Hur in Judah's genealogy, and founder of Beth-gader; the chapter uses his name to mark a town's clan.

harim.title: Harim
harim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harim.note: The third priestly course in 1 Chronicles 24:8 went by this name, and the family came back from exile. Some of them were among the men Ezra confronted for marrying foreign wives.

harnepher.title: Harnepher
harnepher.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harnepher.note: Zophah's son, a chief of Asher, in 1 Chronicles 7:36. Nothing beyond the name survives.

harorite.title: Harorite
harorite.note: It is what Chronicles calls Shammoth, one of David's mighty men, where Samuel's list has Shammah the Harodite.

harum.title: Harum
harum.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harum.note: Aharhel's father, in Judah's genealogy at 1 Chronicles 4:8.

haruphite.title: Haruphite
haruphite.note: Shephatiah, a Benjamite archer and slinger, came from Hariph and joined David at Ziklag while David was still hiding from Saul.

hasadiah.title: Hasadiah
hasadiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hasadiah.note: In David's royal line after the exile, one of Pedaiah's sons. Nothing else about him is recorded.

hasenuah-including-the-art.title: Hasenuah
hasenuah-including-the-art.note: The Hebrew name carries the article, the Senuah. A Benjamite family that settled in Jerusalem after the exile traced itself back to him.

hashabiah-6.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-6.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashabiah-6.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

hashabiah-3.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah-3.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

hashabiah-2.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
hashabiah-2.note: One of 10 men called Hashabiah. This one is a Levite from the united kingdom, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hashabiah-4.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashabiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

hashabiah-5.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashabiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hashem.title: Hashem
hashem.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
hashem.note: A Gizonite. His sons were among David's mighty men. Samuel's parallel list calls him Jashen.

hashub.title: Hashub
hashub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
hashub.note: The Levite of this name in the lists of those living in Jerusalem after the return.

hashubah.title: Hashubah
hashubah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashubah.note: David's line, after the exile: one of the sons listed after Zerubbabel in the royal genealogy.

hattush-2.title: Hattush
hattush-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hattush-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

havilah.title: Havilah
havilah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
havilah.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

havilah-2.title: Havilah
havilah-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
havilah-2.note: Cush's son in Genesis 10:7. The same name is also a land rich in gold by Eden's rivers, and a son of Joktan, so it may cover more than one region.

hazar-shual.title: Hazar-shual
hazar-shual.note: Village of the jackal. It sat on Judah's southern border and later fell inside Simeon's share, and people came back to live there after the exile. It is commonly placed near Tell es-Sa'weh, between Beersheba and Moladah.

hazar-susim.title: Hazar-susim
hazar-susim.note: The same town Joshua calls Hazar-susah. In the Simeonite clan lists of 1 Chronicles 4:31 the name is plural, village of horses.

hazarmaveth.title: Hazarmaveth
hazarmaveth.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hazarmaveth.note: Joktan's son, in the Arabian branch of Shem's descendants. The name survives almost unchanged in Hadramawt, a region of southern Arabia in Yemen known in the ancient world for frankincense and spice.

hazelelponi.title: Hazelelponi
hazelelponi.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hazelelponi.note: A woman in Judah's genealogy, sister of the sons of Etam. Nothing further is recorded about her.

haziel.title: Haziel
haziel.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
haziel.note: He was a Gershonite Levite, through Shimei, in the lists David drew up for temple service.

heber-3.title: Heber
heber-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
heber-3.note: One of 4 men called Heber. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

heber-4.title: Heber
heber-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
heber-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

heber.title: Heber
heber.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
heber.note: Not the Kenite. This Heber is in Genesis 46:17 among the family that went down to Egypt, and Numbers 26:45 makes him the head of a clan.

hebron.title: Hebron
hebron.note: Abraham camped near here at Mamre and bought the cave of Machpelah to bury Sarah. It sits in the hill country south of Jerusalem, once called Kirjath-arba, and Joshua gave it to Caleb. David reigned there seven years before moving to Jerusalem, and Herod's great stone enclosure over the traditional tomb still stands.

hebron-2.title: Hebron
hebron-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebron-2.note: Kohath's son, a Levite, and a clan of Levites came from him.

hebron-3.title: Hebron
hebron-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hebron-3.note: One of 3 men called Hebron. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hebronites.title: Hebronites
hebronites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebronites.note: They were Levites of Kohath's line, through his son Hebron. Under David they were put over Israelite land west of the Jordan and over treasuries tied to the temple.

helah.title: Helah
helah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
helah.note: One of the two wives of Ashur, founder of Tekoa, in Judah's genealogy.

heldai-2.title: Heldai
heldai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
heldai-2.note: Two men. One was over David's army in the twelfth month, a Netophathite. The other came back from Babylon with gold and silver, and Zechariah was told to make a crown from it for Joshua the high priest.

heled.title: Heled
heled.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
heled.note: Chronicles has this name among David's thirty where Samuel has Heleb son of Baanah.

helem-2.title: Helem
helem-2.note: Of Asher, through Beriah's line, in the tribal genealogy at 1 Chronicles 7:35.

helez-2.title: Helez
helez-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
helez-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

helez.title: Helez
helez.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy

heman-3.title: Heman
heman-3.note: One of 3 men called Heman. This one is a man from the years before the monarchy, named once in 1 Chronicles.

heman.title: Heman
heman.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
heman.note: David put him among the chief musicians over the worship, a Levite. Psalm 88, one of the darkest laments in the book, is credited to him.

hepher-4.title: Hepher
hepher-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hepher-4.note: One of 4 men called Hepher. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

hepher-3.title: Hepher
hepher-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hepher-3.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

heresh.title: Heresh
heresh.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
heresh.note: One of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem after the exile, from the gatekeepers who came out of the singers' guild.

hermon.title: Hermon
hermon.note: On Israel's northern border, and the snowmelt off it gives the Psalms their picture of dew. It is near Caesarea Philippi, which makes it a likely site for Jesus's transfiguration.

heshbon.title: Heshbon
heshbon.note: Sihon's capital, east of the Jordan near the northern edge of Moab. Moses took it before Israel crossed into Canaan, and it became a Levitical city in Reuben. Moab later had it back, which is why the prophets name it in their judgments on Moab, and the ruins, still called Hesban, lie about twenty miles east of the Jordan.

heth.title: Heth
heth.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
heth.note: Canaan's son and the father of the Hittites, the people Abraham bought Sarah's burial cave from and the people Uriah, Bathsheba's husband, came from generations later.

hezeki.title: Hezeki
hezeki.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hezeki.note: A Benjamite descended from Elpaal, in the Chronicles genealogy, and that is the whole entry.

hezekiah.title: Hezekiah
hezekiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hezekiah.note: One of Judah's few good kings. He came after Ahaz, reopened the temple, tore down the high places, and broke up the bronze serpent Moses had made once people began worshipping it. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem in 701 BC, Hezekiah prayed, Isaiah promised deliverance, and the siege broke overnight. His seal impression has been dug up near the Temple Mount, and his tunnel still runs under the city.

hezir.title: Hezir
hezir.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hezir.note: Head of the seventeenth of the priestly divisions David set up for temple service. A first-century BC tomb in the Kidron Valley names a priestly family called the Sons of Hezir, so the name stayed in Jerusalem's priesthood a long time.

hezro.title: Hezro
hezro.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
hezro.note: Called the Carmelite, he stands among David's mighty warriors in both lists of them. Nothing else is recorded about him.

hezron.title: Hezron
hezron.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hezron.note: Perez's son, and the line that ends in David runs through him; Ruth closes with it and Matthew picks it up. The same name marks a spot on Judah's southern border, west of Kadesh-barnea.

hezron-2.title: Hezron
hezron-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hezron-2.note: Reuben's son, listed with the family that went down to Egypt and again in Reuben's line in Exodus and Chronicles. He is a different man from Perez's son of the same name.

hilen.title: Hilen
hilen.note: Joshua's list calls it Holon. It was a town of Judah handed over, with its pasturelands, to Aaron's descendants among the Levites, and nobody knows where it stood.

hillkiah.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah.note: The high priest under Josiah who found a forgotten scroll of the law while the temple was being repaired. What he found set off Judah's last great reform.

hillkiah-5.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah-5.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

hillkiah-4.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

hittite.title: Hittite
hittite.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hittite.note: Ephron the Hittite sold Abraham the cave of Machpelah at Hebron, and Uriah, the soldier whose wife David took, was a Hittite too. Critics once doubted there was ever a Hittite nation, until digs at Boghazkoy in Turkey found its capital. The Hittites in Canaan were probably a smaller offshoot, or the name used loosely.

hivite.title: Hivite
hivite.note: One of the peoples in the land before Israel. At Shechem a Hivite's son raped Dinah, and at Gibeon Hivites tricked Joshua into a treaty by pretending to come from far off, which put the city under Israel's protection.

hod.title: Hod
hod.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hod.note: Son of Zophah, of Asher, and one verse is all there is.

hodaiah.title: Hodaiah
hodaiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hodaiah.note: After the exile the royal line of Judah keeps going in a list, and Hodaiah is in it, a son of Elioenai. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hodaviah.title: Hodaviah
hodaviah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hodaviah.note: A chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh, east of the Jordan. The name means "praise the LORD", and no story goes with it.

hodaviah-2.title: Hodaviah
hodaviah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodaviah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hodesh.title: Hodesh
hodesh.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hodesh.note: Shaharaim sent away two wives, Hushim and Baara, and had sons in Moab by others. Hodesh was one of them, and she is named so her sons, heads of Benjamite families, could be recorded.

hodijah.title: Hodijah
hodijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodijah.note: The name turns up among those who helped the people understand the law after Ezra read it out, and again among the signers of the covenant under Nehemiah; it was a common Levitical name.

homam.title: Homam
homam.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
homam.note: The name is Edomite, from the line of Seir the Horite, and Genesis spells it Hemam.

hori.title: Hori
hori.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
hori.note: In Edom's genealogies he is one of the Horite clan chiefs, and that is all the record gives.

hormah.title: Hormah
hormah.note: Its name means "devoted to destruction", and it was first called Zephath. Israel was beaten there after going into Canaan without the Lord, following the spies' report. Later Israel vowed to destroy the cities of the region, and the vow, kept under Joshua, gave the town its name.

hosah.title: Hosah
hosah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hosah.note: A Levite of Merari's family whom David made a gatekeeper, and his family kept the post after him.

hoshama.title: Hoshama
hoshama.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hoshama.note: Son of Jeconiah, the king of Judah taken to Babylon, and probably born while his father was a prisoner there. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hoshea.title: Hoshea
hoshea.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hoshea.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hotham-2.title: Hotham
hotham-2.note: Heber's son, of Beriah's clan and a chief in Asher; another Hotham turns up among David's warriors.

hotham.title: Hotham
hotham.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hotham.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

hothir.title: Hothir
hothir.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hothir.note: Heman had fourteen sons, and Hothir was one of them. Heman was David's seer and a lead Levite musician, and Hothir led one of the divisions of temple musicians chosen by lot.

hukkok.title: Hukkok
hukkok.note: A Levitical town near the border of Naphtali and Asher, not far from the Jordan. It may be the village of Yakuk near the Sea of Galilee.

hul.title: Hul
hul.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hul.note: Aram's son, Shem's grandson, in the Table of Nations. Like the other names there it probably means a clan or district. Its location is not known.

huppah.title: Huppah
huppah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
huppah.note: In David's reign the priests served by rota, and Huppah headed the thirteenth of the twenty-four divisions.

huppim.title: Huppim
huppim.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
huppim.note: Another of Benjamin's sons, whose descendants became one of the tribe's clans in the genealogies.

hur.title: Hur
hur.about: Aaron's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hur.note: He helped Aaron hold up Moses's arms while Israel fought Amalek, since Israel won as long as those hands stayed up. When Moses went up Sinai for the law, Hur was left in charge with Aaron.

hurai.title: Hurai
hurai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
hurai.note: Chronicles' name for one of David's thirty, from the valley by Mount Gaash in Ephraim. Samuel's list calls him Hiddai.

huram.title: Huram
huram.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
huram.note: Chronicles spells the king of Tyre this way. He is the Hiram who sent materials for Solomon's temple.

huram-3.title: Huram
huram-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
huram-3.note: One of 3 men called Huram. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

huri.title: Huri
huri.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
huri.note: A Gadite in Bashan, east of the Jordan, and father of Abihail. Gad's genealogy runs through him down to family heads in the days of Jotham of Judah and Jeroboam II of Israel. Nothing else is recorded about him.

hushah.title: Hushah
hushah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hushah.note: One name in Judah's genealogy, tied to the descendants of Ezer.

hushai.title: Hushai
hushai.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
hushai.note: David's friend, who stayed behind when Absalom rebelled so he could work from inside Absalom's court. Ahithophel gave Absalom sound advice, Hushai talked him into a worse plan, and the time it bought saved David.

husham.title: Husham
husham.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
husham.note: He was king of Edom in the days before Israel had any king.

hushathite.title: Hushathite
hushathite.note: Two of David's mighty men carry this label, Sibbecai and Mebunnai, and it ties them to Hushah in Judah's genealogy. Sibbecai is also the one who killed a Philistine giant in a later battle at Gob.

hushim-2.title: Hushim
hushim-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hushim-2.note: One of 3 men called Hushim. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

hushim.title: Hushim
hushim.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hushim.note: One of the wives of a Benjamite clan leader in the Chronicles genealogy. The same name belongs to a son of Dan.

ibhar.title: Ibhar
ibhar.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
ibhar.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, after he was king, and nothing more.

ibneiah.title: Ibneiah
ibneiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ibneiah.note: Jeroham's son, a Benjamite, among the family heads who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

ibnijah.title: Ibnijah
ibnijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ibnijah.note: After the exile he was one of the Benjamite family heads living in Jerusalem, and that is the extent of him.

ibri.title: Ibri
ibri.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ibri.note: A Merarite Levite of Jaaziah's family, in the Levitical divisions of David's time. Nothing further is recorded about him.

idbash.title: Idbash
idbash.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
idbash.note: One of three sons of "the father of Etam", in Judah's genealogy, with a sister named Hazelelponi.

iddo-5.title: Iddo
iddo-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
iddo-5.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

iddo-4.title: Iddo
iddo-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
iddo-4.note: Named once, in a list of tribal officers in Chronicles, and that is all the record holds.

igal.title: Igal
igal.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
igal.note: One of 3 men called Igal. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ikkesh.title: Ikkesh
ikkesh.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ikkesh.note: His son Ira, from Tekoa, was one of David's mighty warriors.

ilai.title: Ilai
ilai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ilai.note: An Ahohite among David's chief warriors. Samuel's list has Zalmon in his place.

immer-2.title: Immer
immer-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
immer-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

immer.title: Immer
immer.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
immer.note: Head of one of David's twenty-four priestly divisions, and his family name comes back with the returning exiles.

imna-2.title: Imna
imna-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
imna-2.note: A later man of Asher's line, in Chronicles, distinct from Asher's own son of the same name.

imna.title: Imna
imna.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
imna.note: A son of Asher. Genesis, Numbers and Chronicles all list him. Numbers counts a clan from him.

imrah.title: Imrah
imrah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
imrah.note: Zophah's son, in Asher's family lines in Chronicles.

imri.title: Imri
imri.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
imri.note: His family, from Judah, was among those who resettled Jerusalem after the exile. Chronicles gives his name as an ancestor and nothing about him.

iphedeiah.title: Iphedeiah
iphedeiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
iphedeiah.note: One of Benjamin's chiefs, in the Chronicles genealogy of families settled in Jerusalem.

ir.title: Ir
ir.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ir.note: A hard verse in Benjamin's genealogy, and many read this name as a variant of Iri, Bela's son a few verses earlier. Nothing else is known.

ira-2.title: Ira
ira-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ira-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

ira.title: Ira
ira.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ira.note: One of David's elite warriors, who in Chronicles also commands one of the monthly army divisions. Ira was the name of more than one of David's men.

iram.title: Iram
iram.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
iram.note: A clan chief of Edom, from Esau's descendants in the hill country of Seir.

iri.title: Iri
iri.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
iri.note: Bela's son and Benjamin's grandson, head of a family in Benjamin's genealogy.

irnahash.title: Irnahash
irnahash.note: "City of the serpent", one of the town names in Judah's genealogy. Nobody knows where it was.

iru.title: Iru
iru.note: Caleb's eldest son. Caleb was the faithful spy who got Hebron. Nothing further is recorded about Iru.

isaac.title: Isaac
isaac.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
isaac.note: Abraham and Sarah's promised son, born when his father was a hundred. God told Abraham to sacrifice him on Mount Moriah and provided a ram at the last moment. Old and blind, he was tricked by Jacob into giving him Esau's blessing, and he never left Canaan or took a second wife.

isaiah.title: Isaiah
isaiah.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
isaiah.note: Amoz's son, a prophet in Jerusalem in the eighth century, who counselled four kings of Judah and is quoted in the New Testament more than any other prophet. He gave his two sons names that were sermons, Shear-jashub and Maher-shalal-hash-baz. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem he told Hezekiah the city would stand, and the Taylor Prism brags of the siege without ever claiming the city fell.

ishbah.title: Ishbah
ishbah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishbah.note: "Father of Eshtemoa" in Judah's genealogy, which probably means he founded the town's settlement rather than fathered a son. Nothing else is recorded about him.

ishbak.title: Ishbak
ishbak.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishbak.note: Abraham had him by Keturah. He is usually taken as the ancestor of an Arabian tribe, but nobody can say which.

ishi.title: Ishi
ishi.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi.note: Named once in Judah's genealogy. The word means "my husband", and Hosea uses it for Israel coming back to God, in place of the colder "my master".

ishi-2.title: Ishi
ishi-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ishi-3.title: Ishi
ishi-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi-3.note: One of 4 men called Ishi. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ishi-4.title: Ishi
ishi-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi-4.note: A name in the genealogies of Judah and Manasseh. The word itself means my husband, and Hosea uses it for what Israel will call God again.

ishiah-3.title: Ishiah
ishiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishiah-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

ishiah.title: Ishiah
ishiah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishiah.note: A Levite in the lists of temple divisions, named twice in Chronicles. Isshiah was a common Levitical name.

ishiah-2.title: Ishiah
ishiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishiah-2.note: One of 5 men called Ishiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ishiah-4.title: Ishiah
ishiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishiah-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ishma.title: Ishma
ishma.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishma.note: One name in a short, tangled fragment of Judah's genealogy, grouped with Etam.

ishmael-2.title: Ishmael
ishmael-2.about: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishmael-2.note: Abraham's first son, by Hagar, Sarah's servant. Sarah had given Hagar to Abraham while she was still childless, then wanted mother and son gone after Isaac came. God promised Hagar her son would father a great nation too, though the covenant line ran through Isaac.

ishmael-3.title: Ishmael
ishmael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmael-3.note: One of 6 men called Ishmael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

ishmaelite.title: Ishmaelite
ishmaelite.about: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishmaelite.note: The Ishmaelites came from Abraham's son Ishmael and traded across the country south and east of Canaan. One of their caravans bought Joseph from his brothers and took him down to Egypt.

ishmaiah-2.title: Ishmaiah
ishmaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmaiah-2.note: A ruler over Zebulun in David's organisation of the tribes.

ishmaiah.title: Ishmaiah
ishmaiah.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmaiah.note: A Gibeonite who came over to David at Ziklag while David was still on the run from Saul, and a leader among the thirty.

ishmerai.title: Ishmerai
ishmerai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmerai.note: From Elpaal's family, a Benjamite household head in Jerusalem, and nothing more is said of him.

ishod.title: Ishod
ishod.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishod.note: Hammoleketh's son, of the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.

ishpan.title: Ishpan
ishpan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishpan.note: A Benjamite listed under Shashak's family, and that is all.

ishuai.title: Ishuai
ishuai.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishuai.note: One of the household that went down to Egypt, named again in the Numbers census with a clan of his own and once more in Chronicles.

ishvah.title: Ishvah
ishvah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishvah.note: A son of Asher who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. Numbers leaves him out of Asher's clans, which may mean he founded no line.

ispah.title: Ispah
ispah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ispah.note: A Benjamite family head from Beriah's line who lived in Jerusalem.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

issachar.title: Issachar
issachar.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
issachar.note: Jacob's ninth son. His tribe held the fertile Jezreel Valley, and Chronicles says its men understood the times and knew what Israel ought to do.

issachar-2.title: Issachar
issachar-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
issachar-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the united kingdom.

ithai-2.title: Ithai
ithai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ithai-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a warrior from the united kingdom.

ithamar.title: Ithamar
ithamar.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ithamar.note: Aaron's youngest son. Two of his brothers died for offering unauthorized fire and Eleazar became high priest, and Ithamar was put over the Levites who carried and kept the tabernacle. Eli came from his line, which held the high priesthood for a while before it went back to Eleazar's line under Zadok.

ithmah.title: Ithmah
ithmah.about: Moabite warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ithmah.note: David's mighty men included a Moabite, and this is him.

ithran.title: Ithran
ithran.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
ithran.note: A Horite clan name, from Edom's earlier inhabitants.

ithran-2.title: Ithran
ithran-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ithran-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ithream.title: Ithream
ithream.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
ithream.note: David's sixth son born at Hebron, by his wife Eglah, and the story never mentions him again.

ithrite.title: Ithrite
ithrite.note: Ira and Gareb, two of David's mighty men, both carry this label. It may tie them to Kiriath-jearim, but where the name comes from is not known for sure.

izeharites.title: Izeharites
izeharites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izeharites.note: The family of Izhar, Kohath's son. Korah came from them, the Levite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed by the earth.

izhar.title: Izhar
izhar.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izhar.note: He was Kohath's son, and his own son Korah led the rebellion against Moses in the wilderness.

izrahiah.title: Izrahiah
izrahiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
izrahiah.note: Two men. One is a chief of Issachar in the genealogies; the other, generations later, is at the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt walls under Nehemiah.

izrahite.title: Izrahite
izrahite.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izrahite.note: The label on Shamhuth, who commanded David's division for the fifth month. It most likely means he came from Zerah, Judah's son.

jaakan.title: Jaakan
jaakan.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
jaakan.note: Ezer's son, grandson of Seir the Horite, and Genesis calls him Akan. His descendants gave their name to one of Israel's camps in the wilderness.

jaakobah.title: Jaakobah
jaakobah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaakobah.note: A clan leader of Simeon, with a name built on the same root as Jacob.

jaanai.title: Jaanai
jaanai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaanai.note: A Gadite chief in Bashan, named once.

jaasiel-2.title: Jaasiel
jaasiel-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
jaasiel-2.note: Son of Abner, and chief officer over Benjamin in David's administration.

jaasiel.title: Jaasiel
jaasiel.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaasiel.note: He is Jasiel the Mesobaite in the roll of David's mighty warriors.

jaazer.title: Jaazer
jaazer.note: Jazer, an Amorite town in Gilead east of the Jordan. Israel took it and gave it to Gad, then to the Levites of Merari. Isaiah and Jeremiah both use its ruined vineyards as a picture of Moab's ruin.

jaaziah.title: Jaaziah
jaaziah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jaaziah.note: One of Merari's descendants, listed when David set the Levites into divisions for temple service.

jaaziel.title: Jaaziel
jaaziel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaaziel.note: He played the harp when David brought the ark up to Jerusalem, and he is probably the Aziel named two verses later.

jabez-2.title: Jabez
jabez-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

jabez.title: Jabez
jabez.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jabez.note: Jabez prayed for God to bless him and widen his borders, and the text says God did. He is from Judah's genealogy, and the prayer is all we have of him.

jachan.title: Jachan
jachan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jachan.note: A Gadite chief in Bashan, among the family heads, and nothing further is recorded about him.

jachin-2.title: Jachin
jachin-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jachin-2.note: One of 4 men called Jachin. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

jachin-4.title: Jachin
jachin-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jachin-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jacob.title: Jacob
jacob.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
jacob.note: Isaac and Rebekah's younger twin, born holding Esau's heel. He bought his brother's birthright for stew, took his father's blessing by a trick, and ran to his uncle Laban, where he worked fourteen years for Leah and Rachel. On the way home he wrestled all night and came away named Israel. He died in Egypt, near Joseph, and was buried at Machpelah as he had asked.

jada.title: Jada
jada.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jada.note: Onam's son and Shammai's brother, in the Jerahmeelite branch of Judah's family.

jahath-2.title: Jahath
jahath-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahath-2.note: One of 4 men called Jahath. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jahath.title: Jahath
jahath.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahath.note: A Levite of Gershon's line in Chronicles. The name comes up often in the Levite genealogies, for men of both Gershon and Kohath.

jahath-3.title: Jahath
jahath-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahath-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jahaz.title: Jahaz
jahaz.note: Moses beat Sihon, the Amorite king, at Jahaz, on the plateau north of the Arnon. The town went to Reuben and then to the Merarite Levites, and because it changed hands with Moab more than once, Isaiah and Jeremiah both name it in their oracles against Moab.

jahaziel.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahaziel.note: A Levite named twice in the Chronicles lists of Levite families, and nothing more is told of him. Another Jahaziel prophesied to Jehoshaphat.

jahaziel-3.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahaziel-3.note: One of 5 men called Jahaziel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jahaziel-2.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahaziel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

jahdiel.title: Jahdiel
jahdiel.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahdiel.note: One of the family heads of the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.

jahdo.title: Jahdo
jahdo.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahdo.note: Buz's son and Jeshishai's father, in Gad's family east of the Jordan. Nothing further is known of him.

jahmai.title: Jahmai
jahmai.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahmai.note: In David's day he headed a family in the house of Tolah, one of Issachar's clans of fighting men.

jahzerah.title: Jahzerah
jahzerah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jahzerah.note: A priest in the line of those who resettled Jerusalem, Meshullam's son and Adiel's father. Nehemiah's list calls him Ahzai.

jahziel.title: Jahziel
jahziel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahziel.note: Chronicles spells him this way. He is Naphtali's son, head of a clan, and Genesis and Numbers call him Jahzeel.

jair.title: Jair
jair.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jair.note: He judged Israel twenty-two years. His thirty sons rode thirty donkeys and held thirty towns, which says money and reach, not battles won.

jair-3.title: Jair
jair-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
jair-3.note: Not the judge, and not Jair of Gilead. This Jair was father of Elhanan, the warrior of David's who killed Lahmi, Goliath's brother.

jakim.title: Jakim
jakim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jakim.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jakim-2.title: Jakim
jakim-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jakim-2.note: A Benjamite family head living in Jerusalem, in the Chronicles genealogy.

jalam.title: Jalam
jalam.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
jalam.note: Esau's son by Oholibamah, whose descendants became one of Edom's clans.

jalon.title: Jalon
jalon.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jalon.note: Last of the four sons of Ezra in Judah's genealogy, and nothing further is known of him.

jamin-2.title: Jamin
jamin-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jamin-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jamin.title: Jamin
jamin.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jamin.note: One of Simeon's sons, in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers and Chronicles. The name was common.

jamlech.title: Jamlech
jamlech.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jamlech.note: A chief of Simeon's clans. Nothing else is recorded about him.

japheth.title: Japheth
japheth.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
japheth.note: Noah's son. With Shem he covered their drunken father without looking, and Noah asked God to enlarge Japheth's territory. Genesis 10 traces his descendants to the peoples of Asia Minor and the Aegean.

japhia.title: Japhia
japhia.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
japhia.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, and sharing his name with a king of Lachish and a town of Zebulun.

japhlet.title: Japhlet
japhlet.note: From Asher through Beriah, and head of the Japhletite clan. Nothing else is known of him.

jarah.title: Jarah
jarah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jarah.note: Saul's line runs through Jonathan and Mephibosheth to Micah, and Jarah is Micah's son. The other copy of the list calls him Jehoadah.

jared.title: Jared
jared.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
jared.note: Enoch's father, in Seth's line down to Noah, and he lived nine hundred sixty-two years.

jaresiah.title: Jaresiah
jaresiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaresiah.note: A Benjamite family head, descended from Jeroham.

jarha.title: Jarha
jarha.about: Egyptian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jarha.note: Sheshan had no sons. He gave his daughter to Jarha, his Egyptian servant, to keep the line going. Their descendants run on for generations in Chronicles.

jarib.title: Jarib
jarib.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jarib.note: Ezra sent a Jarib, one of the leaders, to recruit Levites for the return. Chronicles lists a second man of the name in a genealogy.

jaroah.title: Jaroah
jaroah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaroah.note: They list him among the chiefs of Gad in Bashan, and nothing else is recorded of him.

jashobeam.title: Jashobeam
jashobeam.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jashobeam.note: Chief of David's three greatest warriors, credited with killing three hundred men in one fight.

jashobeam-2.title: Jashobeam
jashobeam-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jashobeam-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

jashub.title: Jashub
jashub.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jashub.note: Issachar's son, and his clan was counted in the census of Numbers.

jashubi-lehem.title: Jashubi-lehem
jashubi-lehem.note: Older dictionaries could not decide whether this is a man or a place, "those who returned to Lehem". It sits in the genealogy of Judah through Shelah, and modern translations mostly read it as a place.

jathniel.title: Jathniel
jathniel.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jathniel.note: Meshelemiah's fourth son, a Korahite Levite, and one of the gatekeepers at the temple's entrances under David.

jattir.title: Jattir
jattir.note: A priests' town in the hill country of Judah, given to Aaron's line. David sent its elders a share of the Amalekite plunder, as he did for many towns while he was on the run. It is identified with Khirbet Attir, south of Hebron.

javan.title: Javan
javan.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
javan.note: Japheth's fourth son in the table of nations. The Hebrews took his descendants to be the Ionians, the Greek world, and the prophets use Javan to mean Greece and its merchants. Modern Hebrew still calls Greece by the name.

jaziz.title: Jaziz
jaziz.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaziz.note: King David's flocks were his to look after, and he was a Hagrite.

jeaterai.title: Jeaterai
jeaterai.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeaterai.note: Zerah's son, a Gershonite Levite, in the genealogy of Chronicles. Nothing further is recorded of him.

jebus.title: Jebus
jebus.note: What Jerusalem was called while the Jebusites held it. David took it and made it his capital.

jeconiah.title: Jeconiah
jeconiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeconiah.note: Another name for Jehoiachin, the king of Judah carried off to Babylon. In the end a Babylonian king let him out and gave him a seat at the royal table.

jedaiah.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jedaiah.note: The name was common among priests after the exile. Several who came back from Babylon and served in the rebuilt temple carried it.

jedaiah-2.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jedaiah-2.note: The second priestly division in Chronicles carries his name, and his descendants are counted among the priests who came back from Babylon.

jedaiah-5.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jedaiah-5.note: Named once, in a family line in Chronicles, and not one of the priests who share the name.

jediael-4.title: Jediael
jediael-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jediael-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jediael-3.title: Jediael
jediael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jediael-3.note: One of 4 men called Jediael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jediael.title: Jediael
jediael.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jediael.note: A Benjamite clan head, whose family is counted among the fighting men in Chronicles.

jediael-2.title: Jediael
jediael-2.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jediael-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a warrior from the divided-kingdom years.

jeduthun-2.title: Jeduthun
jeduthun-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jeduthun-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

jeduthun.title: Jeduthun
